ground_truth_en: Waki' bin Hudus narrated that his paternal uncle Abu Razin said:                     "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, will we see Allah on the Day of Resurrection? And what is the sign of that in His creation?' He said: 'O Abu Razin, do each of you not see the moon individually?' I said: 'Of course.' He said: 'Allah is Greater, and that is His sign in His creation.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، أنبأنا حماد بن سلمة، عن يعلى بن عطاء، عن وكيع بن حدس، عن عمه أبي رزين، قال قلت يا رسول الله أكلنا يرى الله يوم القيامة وما آية ذلك في خلقه قال ‏"‏ يا أبا رزين أليس كلكم يرى القمر مخليا به ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال قلت بلى ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فالله أعظم وذلك آيته في خلقه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed as he pleased; so he said to him, “He is not from my Ummah.”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saidtheTakbir seven and five times in (the prayer for ‘Eid) Fitr andAdha,apart from the Takbir for Ruku’ (bowing).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني ابن لهيعة، عن خالد بن يزيد، وعقيل، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كبر في الفطر والأضحى سبعا وخمسا سوى تكبيرتى الركوع ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer with his hands raised until he saw a cloud in the sky, then he lowered them and finished praying.” Then Hudhayf bin Al Yaman came forward and said, "I once did this." So Allah’s Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade that. He said, “Do not wait for clouds to pass over you while you are performing your prayer; rather perform it before they come or after they have passed away.”

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn`Umar said:                     “I was presented to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of Uhud, when I was fourteen years old, but he did not permit me (to fight). I was presented to him on the Day of Khandaq when I was fifteen years old, and he permitted me (to fight).' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير، وأبو معاوية وأبو أسامة قالوا حدثنا عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال عرضت على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم أحد وأنا ابن أربع عشرة سنة فلم يجزني وعرضت عليه يوم الخندق وأنا ابن خمس عشرة سنة فأجازني ‏.‏ قال نافع فحدثت به عمر بن عبد العزيز في خلافته فقال هذا فصل ما بين الصغير والكبير ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from giving in charity until he had paid back his debt.”

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، وعمرو بن عبد الله، قالا حدثنا وكيع، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن نسير بن ذعلوق، قال كان ابن عمر يقول لا تسبوا أصحاب محمد  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فلمقام أحدهم ساعة خير من عمل أحدكم عمره ‏.‏

ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Ali said:                     “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me to Yemen. ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا يعلى، وأبو معاوية عن الأعمش، عن عمرو بن مرة، عن أبي البختري، عن علي، قال بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى اليمن فقلت يا رسول الله تبعثني وأنا شاب أقضي بينهم ولا أدري ما القضاء قال فضرب في صدري بيده ثم قال ‏"‏ اللهم اهد قلبه وثبت لسانه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فما شككت بعد في قضاء بين اثنين ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Anas that:                     Umm Sulaim asked the Messenger of Allah about a woman who sees in her dream something like that which a man sees. The Messenger of Allah said: "If she sees that and has a discharge, then let her perform a bath." Umm Salamah said: "O Messenger of Allah, does that really happen?" He said: "Yes, the water of the man is thick and white and the water of a woman is thin and yellow. Whichever of them comes first or predominates, the child will resemble (that parent)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، وعبد الأعلى، عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن أنس، أن أم سليم، سألت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن المرأة ترى في منامها ما يرى الرجل فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا رأت ذلك فأنزلت فعليها الغسل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقالت أم سلمة يا رسول الله أيكون هذا قال ‏"‏ نعم ماء الرجل غليظ أبيض وماء المرأة رقيق أصفر فأيهما سبق أو علا أشبهه الولد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who used to pray as usual but then became negligent in his prayers; so, he was advised to perform Wudu before each prayer. He said: “Do you know what the Prophet (peace be upon him) did?” The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) ordered me to bring my cat, and I brought it to him. Then he stroked its belly and said, "Rub your bellies against the wall."

chapter: Supplication - كتاب الدعاء
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Bakr Siddiq that :                     he said to the Messenger of Allah (saas): "Teach me a supplication which I can say during my prayer." He said: "Say: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfirudh-dhunub illa Anta, faghfirli maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni, innaka Antal-Ghafurur-Rahim (O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly and no one forgives sins but You, so grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy on me, for You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، حدثنا الليث بن سعد، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن أبي الخير، عن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، عن أبي بكر الصديق، ‏.‏ أنه قال لرسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  علمني دعاء أدعو به في صلاتي ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ قل اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلما كثيرا ولا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت فاغفر لي مغفرة من عندك وارحمني إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated ‘Ali ibn Abi Talhah said: “I asked Abu Huraira about a Hadith which I heard from my father, who had heard it from his father, that 'Whoever makes supplication with his hands while standing, Allah will answer him.' So Abu Huraira told me to ask Ibn Mas’ud.” Then I asked Ibn Mas'ud and he said: “I have not heard this from the Prophet. But I once saw ‘Uthman ibn Abi Taliah making supplications in congregation whilst standing up with his hands raised until his fingers were like hooks, so Allah answered him immediately by sending down a rain upon us.”

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abdur-Rahman bin Tha’labah Al-Ansari, from his father, that Amr bin Samurah bin Habib bin Abd Shams came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said:                     “O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! I stole a camel belonging to Banu so-and-so; purify me!” The Prophet (ﷺ) sent word to them and they said: “(Yes), we have lost a camel of ours.” So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that his hand be cut off. Tha'labah said: “I was looking at him when his hand fell and he said (to it) 'Praise is to Allah (STW) Who has purified me of you; you wanted to cause my whole body to enter Hell.'''
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا ابن أبي مريم، أنبأنا ابن لهيعة، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن عبد الرحمن بن ثعلبة الأنصاري، عن أبيه، أن عمرو بن سمرة بن حبيب بن عبد شمس، جاء إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال يا رسول الله إني سرقت جملا لبني فلان فطهرني ‏.‏ فأرسل إليهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا إنا افتقدنا جملا لنا فأمر به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقطعت يده ‏.‏ قال ثعلبة أنا أنظر إليه حين وقعت يده وهو يقول الحمد لله الذي طهرني منك أردت أن تدخلي جسدي النار ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him: “The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from giving in charity until he had paid back his debt.”

ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When the last people of this Ummah curse the first, (at that time) whoever conceals a Hadith will be concealing what Allah has revealed.'" (Maudu')
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الحسين بن أبي السري العسقلاني، حدثنا خلف بن تميم، عن عبد الله بن السري، عن محمد بن المنكدر، عن جابر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا لعن آخر هذه الأمة أولها فمن كتم حديثا فقد كتم ما أنزل الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏

Indeed, when he prayed, he intended for himself and his family only, while if he had intended for all mankind, Allah would have accepted his prayer."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibrahim bin ‘Abdullah bin Hunain, from his father,that ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas and Miswar bin Makhramah disagreed atAbwa’. Abdullah bin ‘Abbas said that the Muhrim may wash hishead, and Miswar said that the Muhrim may not wash his head.Ibn ‘Abbas sent me to Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari to ask him about that, and I found him taking a bath near the well, screened with a piece of cloth. I greeted him with Salam, and he said:                      “Who is this?” I said: “I am ‘Abdullah bin Hunain. ‘Abdullah bin ‘Abbas sent me to you to ask you how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to wash his head when he was in Ihram.” He said: “Abu Ayyub put his hand on the cloth and lowered it until his head appeared, then he said to someone who was pouring water for him, Pour water. So he poured water on his head. Then he rubbed his head with his hands, forwards and backwards, and said: ‘This is what I saw him (ﷺ) doing.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو مصعب، حدثنا مالك، عن زيد بن أسلم، عن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين، عن أبيه، أن عبد الله بن عباس، والمسور بن مخرمة، اختلفا بالأبواء فقال عبد الله بن عباس يغسل المحرم رأسه ‏.‏ وقال المسور بن مخرمة لا يغسل المحرم رأسه ‏.‏ فأرسلني ابن عباس إلى أبي أيوب الأنصاري أسأله عن ذلك، فوجدته يغتسل بين القرنين وهو يستتر بثوب فسلمت عليه فقال من هذا قلت أنا عبد الله بن حنين أرسلني إليك عبد الله بن عباس أسألك كيف كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يغسل رأسه وهو محرم قال فوضع أبو أيوب يده على الثوب فطأطأه حتى بدا لي رأسه ثم قال لإنسان يصب عليه اصبب ‏.‏ فصب على رأسه ثم حرك رأسه بيديه فأقبل بهما وأدبر ‏.‏ ثم قال هكذا رأيته  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يفعل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about his (Jaaber's) Hajj ritual, so Jaaber said to him, "I used to perform Tawaf seven times around the Kaaba while holding a stone in my hand and reciting verses from the Book of Allah. Then I would proceed towards Maqam Ibrahim and recite there." He further stated that he did this during his first three hajj journeys.

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Asim bin ‘Amr said:                      “A group from the people of‘Iraq came to ‘Umar and when they came to him, he said to them:‘Whereare you from?’ They said: ‘From the inhabitants of‘Iraq.’ He said:‘Have you come with permission?’ They said:‘Yes.’ Then they asked himabout a man’s prayer in his house.‘Umar said: ‘I asked the Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) and he said:“As for a man’s prayer in his house, it islight, so illuminateyour houses.’””
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن طارق، عن عاصم بن عمرو، قال خرج نفر من أهل العراق إلى عمر فلما قدموا عليه قال لهم ممن أنتم قالوا من أهل العراق ‏.‏ قال فبإذن جئتم قالوا نعم ‏.‏ قال فسألوه عن صلاة الرجل في بيته ‏.‏ فقال عمر سألت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ أما صلاة الرجل في بيته فنور فنوروا بيوتكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “A man prayed Asr prayer with a small number of Rak'ahs (units) – either three or four - and he did not say any Takbir. Then someone asked him about it and he replied, 'I was afraid that if I made Takbir, then the Prayer would be invalidated.' So Ibn Abbas said to him: ‘You have done right.’”

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "Usamah stumbled at the threshold of the door and cut his face. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Remove the harm (the blood) from him,' but I was repulsed by that. He started to suck the blood and remove it from his face, then he said: 'If Usamah were a girl, I would have adorned him and dressed him until I married him off."'
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا شريك، عن العباس بن ذريح، عن البهي، عن عائشة، قالت عثر أسامة بعتبة الباب فشج في وجهه فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أميطي عنه الأذى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتقذرته فجعل يمص عنه الدم ويمجه عن وجهه ثم قال ‏"‏ لو كان أسامة جارية لحليته وكسوته حتى أنفقه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who had married a woman from his tribe whom she then left him; should he divorce her? He said, “Yes, you should divorce her. Verily, Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade marrying a woman of the Banu Tamim.” Then I heard Abu Huraira saying that Jaafir bin Jabr asked him about a man who had married a woman from his tribe whom she then left him; he said “Yes, you should divorce her. Verily, Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade marrying a woman of the Banu Tamim.”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Samurah bin Jundub that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                     “Whenthe Imam says the Salam, then respond to him.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا إسماعيل بن عياش، حدثنا أبو بكر الهذلي، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن سمرة بن جندب، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا سلم الإمام فردوا عليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaafir bin Sumrad about praying Ashura (the tenth of Muharram) and he replied, 'Yes, there is no harm in it.' So I went with some people to pray Asr prayer on the day of Aashurah. Then Allah’s Messenger (peace be upon him) came out towards us and said, ‘Do you make a special occasion for this day?’ They replied, ‘No.’ He then prayed Ashr with them.”

ground_truth_en: Ma’rufbin Kharrabudh Al-Makki narrated:                      “I heard Abu Tufail, ‘AmirbinWathilah, say: ‘I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing Tawaf on hiscamel, touching the corner with his staff and kissing the staff.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، ح وحدثنا هدية بن عبد الوهاب، حدثنا الفضل بن موسى، قالا حدثنا معروف بن خربوذ المكي، قال سمعت أبا الطفيل، عامر بن واثلة قال رأيت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يطوف بالبيت على راحلته يستلم الركن بمحجنه ويقبل المحجن ‏.‏

chapter: The Chapters on Rulings - كتاب الأحكام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:                     he said that two men laid claim to an animal, and neither of them had any proof, so the Prophet (ﷺ) commanded them to cast lots as to which of them should swear an oath.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا خالد بن الحارث، حدثنا سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن خلاس، عن أبي رافع، عن أبي هريرة، أنه ذكر أن رجلين، ادعيا دابة ولم يكن بينهما بينة فأمرهما النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يستهما على اليمين ‏.‏

Indeed, We have killed your rivalry in times past. Therefore, do not die except in the path of Islam."

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “We went out with the Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) when there were five nights left of Dhul-Qa’dah,intendingonly to perform Hajj. When we came close, the Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ)ordered that whoever did not have a sacrificial animal,then he shouldexit the Ihram. So all the people exited Ihram, exceptthose who hadthe sacrificial animal. When the Day of Sacrifice i.e.,the 10th ofDhul-Hijjah) came, some beef was brought tous, and it was said: ‘TheMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) has offered asacrifice on behalf of hiswives.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن عمرة، عن عائشة، قالت خرجنا مع رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  لخمس بقين من ذي القعدة لا نرى إلا الحج حتى إذا قدمنا ودنونا أمر رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  من لم يكن معه هدى أن يحل فحل الناس كلهم إلا من كان معه هدى فلما كان يوم النحر دخل علينا بلحم بقر فقيل ذبح رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن أزواجه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about his (Jaaber's) Hajj ritual, so Jaaber said to him, "I used to perform Tawaf seven times around the Kaaba while holding a stone in my hand and reciting verses from the Book of Allah. Then I would proceed towards Maqam Ibrahim and recite there." He further stated that he did this during his first three hajj journeys.

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أنبأنا الثوري، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت قالت قريش نحن قواطن البيت لا نجاوز الحرم ‏.‏ فقال الله عز وجل ‏{ثم أفيضوا من حيث أفاض الناس }‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about his fast during Hajj, so Jaaber said: “I used to fast every day of my pilgrimage.” Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade me from doing that.

chapter: Interpretation of Dreams - كتاب تعبير الرؤيا
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Abdullah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Whoeversees me in a dream, has seen me in reality, for Satan cannot appearinmy form.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، عن أبي إسحاق، عن أبي الأحوص، عن عبد الله، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من رآني في المنام فقد رآني في اليقظة فإن الشيطان لا يتمثل على صورتي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, “The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'If a person has a dream from his Lord, he should say, "O Allah, if you reveal to me something of your knowledge through this dream, then let it be good for me and for my parents."’ Then he added, ‘And if the dreamer is afraid in his sleep, he should say, “O Allah, I am fearful in my sleep. If this dream comes from You, make it a source of comfort to me.”’”

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn Mas'ud that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                     "There is no one who deals in usury a great deal (to increase his wealth) but he will end up with little (i.e., his wealth will be decreased)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا العباس بن جعفر، حدثنا عمرو بن عون، حدثنا يحيى بن أبي زائدة، عن إسرائيل، عن ركين بن الربيع بن عميلة، عن أبيه، عن ابن مسعود، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ ما أحد أكثر من الربا إلا كان عاقبة أمره إلى قلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Adiy: I asked Abu Huraira: "Is it permissible to sell a thing while knowing that its price is less than its value?" He said, “Yes.” I then asked him about selling a garment for one hundred dirhams when the cloth was worth two hundred. He replied, ‘No, you should not do so.’

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا معلى بن منصور، ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن منصور، وأحمد بن سنان، قالا حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، قالا حدثنا مالك بن أنس، عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل، عن عروة، عن زينب، عن أم سلمة، أنها مرضت فأمرها رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن تطوف من وراء الناس وهي راكبة ‏.‏ قالت فرأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يصلي إلى البيت وهو يقرأ ‏{والطور * وكتاب مسطور}‏ ‏.‏ قال ابن ماجه هذا حديث أبي بكر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about what Allah had ordered him to perform in Hajj, so Jaaber said: “You should circumambulate between the Black Stone and Al-Safaa until you reach Salam; then you should face Baitullah (Kaaba) and pray two Rak’ahs. Then you should run between Safa and Marwa seven times.”

llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who used to pray as usual but then died while his prayer was being answered, so Allah inflicted upon him punishment in the Hereafter. He said, “Do you advise me to perform ablution after praying?” So I replied, "Yes." Then I performed ablution and prayed again, and he (Allah) accepted my second prayer.

I saw the MessengerofAllah (ﷺ) and most of the time he turned to his left.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، ح وحدثنا أبو بكر بن خلاد، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قالا حدثنا الأعمش، عن عمارة، عن الأسود، قال قال عبد الله لا يجعلن أحدكم للشيطان في نفسه جزءا يرى أن حقا لله عليه أن لا ينصرف إلا عن يمينه قد رأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أكثر انصرافه عن يساره ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaafar bin Aboahurairah about praying behind a man who was wearing musk and had not purified himself from it; should he be prayed for?” He replied, "No, you should not pray with such a person."

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Urwah Al-Bariqi that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)said:                      “Goodness is tied to the forelocks of horses until the DayofResurrection.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن شبيب بن غرقدة، عن عروة البارقي، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الخير معقود بنواصي الخيل إلى يوم القيامة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: “There should be no Friday congregation without a sermon in which you mention that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and messenger, and that the prayer is not complete unless it contains *Takbir* (*Allahu Akbar*) from beginning to end, and that Jihad (struggle for Islam) is not only with swords and arrows.”

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الحسن بن علي الخلال، حدثنا بشر بن ثابت البزار، حدثنا نصر بن القاسم، عن عبد الرحمن بن داود، عن صالح بن صهيب، عن أبيه، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ثلاث فيهن البركة البيع إلى أجل والمقارضة وإخلاط البر بالشعير للبيت لا للبيع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: “The one who gives in charity to a brother Muslim while he is intending for it, and does not say, 'I give in the name of Allah,' has given without reward.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri narrated that:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "People will come to you seeking knowledge. When you see them say to them, 'Welcome, welcome,' in obedience to the injunctions of the Messenger of Allah and instruct them in knowledge."(One of the narrators said) "I said to Al-Hakam: 'What is 'Iqnuhum?' He said: 'Instruct them.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الحارث بن راشد المصري، حدثنا الحكم بن عبدة، عن أبي هارون العبدي، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ سيأتيكم أقوام يطلبون العلم فإذا رأيتموهم فقولوا لهم مرحبا مرحبا بوصية رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  واقنوهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت للحكم ما اقنوهم قال علموهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who used to pray as he pleased, without setting times for his prayers; so Allah blessed him with good things. Then I said to him, “Do you advise me to do this?” He replied, "Yes, indeed! Do not set any fixed time for your prayer and if you are delayed, say ‘Oh God, You have no partner, there is nothing worthy of worship except You; my prayers are directed towards You.’"

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that:                     Thawban said: “When the Verse concerning silver and gold was revealed, they said: 'What kind of wealth should we acquire?' Umar said: 'I will tell you about that.' So he rode on his camel and caught up with the Prophet, and I followed him. He said: 'O Messenger of Allah what kind of wealth should we acquire?' He said: 'Let one of acquire a thankful heart, a tongue that remembers Allah and a believing wife who will help him with regard to the Hereafter.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل بن سمرة، حدثنا وكيع، عن عبد الله بن عمرو بن مرة، عن أبيه، عن سالم بن أبي الجعد، عن ثوبان، قال لما نزل في الفضة والذهب ما نزل قالوا فأى المال نتخذ قال عمر فأنا أعلم لكم ذلك ‏.‏ فأوضع على بعيره فأدرك النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وأنا في أثره فقال يا رسول الله أى المال نتخذ فقال ‏"‏ ليتخذ أحدكم قلبا شاكرا ولسانا ذاكرا وزوجة مؤمنة تعين أحدكم على أمر الآخرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who marries a woman because of her beauty; he said: “He is like a gardener who plants a seed, and then he does not water it.”

ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that:                     a man bought a slave and put him to work, then he found some defect in him, so he returned him. He (the seller) said: "O Messenger of Allah he put my slave to work." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "A slave's earnings belong to his guarantor."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا مسلم بن خالد الزنجي، حدثنا هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن رجلا، اشترى عبدا فاستغله ثم وجد به عيبا فرده ‏.‏ فقال يا رسول الله إنه قد استغل غلامي ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ الخراج بالضمان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awliyya asked him about a man who had taken an oath to give his daughter in marriage; he did not keep his word, so I said, “If you could see her!” He replied, "I saw her and she was weeping.” Then the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “Verily, if one takes an oath to marry a woman and does not fulfill it, then he should beat her until she becomes obedient. If that did not work, then he should feed her until she is satisfied."

ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     “Fatimah bint Qais said: 'O Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) I am afraid that someone may enter upon me by force.' So he told her to move."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا حفص بن غياث، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت قالت فاطمة بنت قيس يا رسول الله إني أخاف أن يقتحم على ‏.‏ فأمرها أن تتحول ‏.‏

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) say':                     "Allah said: 'I have divided the prayer between Myself and My slave into two halves, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.'When the slave says: 'Al-hamdulillah i rabbil Alameen (All the praise is to Allah, the Lord of all that exists),' Allah says:'My slave has praised Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Ar-Rahmanir-Rahim (The Mos Gracious, the Most Merciful),' Allah says: 'My slave has extolled Me, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And when he says: 'Maliki yawmiddin [The Only Owner (and he Ruling Judge] if the Day of Recompense],' Allahs says: 'My slave has Glorified Me. This is for Me, and this Verse is between me and My slave in two halves.' And when he says: ' Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nastain [You (Alone) we worship, and You (Alone) we ask for help],' He says: 'This is between Me an My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for.' And the end of the Surah is for My slave.' And when he says: 'Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeema, siratal-alldhina an'amta alayhim a lad-dallin [Guide us to the Straight Way, the way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not(the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray],' He says: 'THis is for My slave, and My slave shall have what he has asked for."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو مروان، محمد بن عثمان العثماني حدثنا عبد العزيز بن أبي حازم، عن العلاء بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، قال سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ قال الله عز وجل قسمت الصلاة بيني وبين عبدي شطرين فنصفها لي ونصفها لعبدي ولعبدي ما سأل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ اقرءوا يقول العبد ‏{الحمد لله رب العالمين}‏ فيقول الله عز وجل حمدني عبدي ولعبدي ما سأل ‏.‏ فيقول ‏{الرحمن الرحيم}‏ فيقول أثنى على عبدي ولعبدي ما سأل ‏.‏ يقول ‏{مالك يوم الدين }‏ فيقول الله مجدني عبدي فهذا لي وهذه الآية بيني وبين عبدي نصفين يقول العبد ‏{إياك نعبد وإياك نستعين}‏ يعني فهذه بيني وبين عبدي ولعبدي ما سأل وآخر السورة لعبدي يقول العبد ‏{اهدنا الصراط المستقيم * صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين}‏ فهذا لعبدي ولعبدي ما سأل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Musa: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who used to say prayers with his hand over his ear, so Jaafar said, “If he is doing this for the sake of Allah, then there is no harm in it.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:                     The Messenger of Allah used to appear before the people during the Hajj season and say: 'Is there any man who can take me to his people, for the Quraish have prevented me from conveying the speech (i.e. the Message) of my Lord.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن رجاء، حدثنا إسرائيل، عن عثمان، - يعني ابن المغيرة الثقفي - عن سالم بن أبي الجعد، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يعرض نفسه على الناس في الموسم فيقول ‏"‏ ألا رجل يحملني إلى قومه فإن قريشا قد منعوني أن أبلغ كلام ربي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him: “Whoever says *As—salamu 'alaikum* (Peace be upon you) sincerely, Allah will grant him a lamp in Hell.”
label: partial

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that:                     Ibn Abbas said: “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) enjoined Zakatul-Fitr as a purification for the fasting person from idle talk and obscenities, and to feed the poor. Whoever pays it before the (Eid) prayer, it is an accepted Zakah, and whoever pays it after the prayer, it is (ordinary) charity.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن أحمد بن بشير بن ذكوان، وأحمد بن الأزهر، قالا حدثنا مروان بن محمد، حدثنا أبو يزيد الخولاني، عن سيار بن عبد الرحمن الصدفي، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال فرض رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  زكاة الفطر طهرة للصائم من اللغو والرفث وطعمة للمساكين فمن أداها قبل الصلاة فهي زكاة مقبولة ومن أداها بعد الصلاة فهي صدقة من الصدقات ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Musa’: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: “Whoever gives Zakat from his property to one who is entitled to it, then seventy thousand angles descend on him every time he breathes.”
label: partial

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Umar said:                     "The Messenger of Allah saw some sputum in the prayer direction of the mosque, when he was praying in front of the people. He scratched it off, then when the prayer was over, he said: 'When anyone of you is performing prayer, Allah is before him, so none of you should spit toward the front while praying.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح المصري، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن نافع، عن عبد الله بن عمر، قال رأى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  نخامة في قبلة المسجد وهو يصلي بين يدى الناس فحتها ثم قال حين انصرف من الصلاة ‏"‏ إن أحدكم إذا كان في الصلاة كان الله قبل وجهه فلا يتنخمن أحدكم قبل وجهه في الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By ‘Uthman ibn Hunayf: I heard my father saying, “It is incumbent upon every Muslim who has an opportunity to attend a mosque that he should go there and listen to Allah’s Messenger (peace be upon him) if he was present.” Then Abu Bakr al-Ash'ari said, "And it is not permissible for anyone to leave the Mosque until he has listened to one of those who are knowledgeable about Islam."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: Ali bin Abi Talib said:                     “I would not pay the blood money (Diyah) for those on whom I carried out the legal punishment, except for the wine-drinker. The Messenger of Allah did not institute anything in that case, rather it is something that we would do.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسماعيل بن موسى، حدثنا شريك، عن أبي حصين، عن عمير بن سعيد، ح وحدثنا عبد الله بن محمد الزهري، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، حدثنا مطرف، سمعته عن عمير بن سعيد، قال قال علي بن أبي طالب ما كنت أدي من أقمت عليه الحد إلا شارب الخمر فإن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لم يسن فيه شيئا إنما هو شىء جعلناه نحن ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'rub: I asked Abu Huraira – may Allah grant him relief - about a man who killed another while defending his father, or his brother, or his neighbor; so he was punished with forty lashes. He said, “He is not to be given any punishment.” Then I asked him again and he repeated the same statement. So I went to Abu Huraira and told him of this matter. He then informed me that Ibn Mas’ud – may Allah have mercy on him - had narrated it from Jabir ibn Abdullah –may Allah grant him relief- who said: “The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon Him) decreed forty lashes for a man who killed another while defending his father, or his brother, or his neighbor.”

chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that:                     The Mesenger of Allah said: "When anyone of enters the mosque, let him send peace upon the Prophet, then let him say: 'Allahumma aftahli abwaba rahmatik (O Allah, open to me the gates of Your mercy).' And when he leaves, let him send peace upon the Prophet and say: 'Allahumma- simni minash-shaitanir-rajim (O Allah, protect me from the accursed Shaitan).'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا أبو بكر الحنفي، حدثنا الضحاك بن عثمان، حدثني سعيد المقبري، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فليسلم على النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وليقل اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك وإذا خرج فليسلم على النبي وليقل اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By ‘Uthman ibn Hunayf: I heard my father saying, “It is recommended that a man should pray seventeen Rak’ahs (units of prayer) in congregation.” Then he said, "I asked Abu Dhar about this and he told me, 'Indeed, it is better to perform forty.'"
label: partial

chapter: The Chapters on Manumission (of Slaves) - كتاب العتق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn`Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever becomes the master of a Mahram relative, he becomes free.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا راشد بن سعيد الرملي، وعبيد الله بن الجهم الأنماطي، قالا حدثنا ضمرة بن ربيعة، عن سفيان، عن عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من ملك ذا رحم محرم فهو حر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who had freed his slave while she was menstruating, and whether her freedom was valid? He said, “Yes.” Then I asked him, "And if the woman was in a state of impurity?" He replied, “Yes."

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “I used to part the hair of theMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) behind his crown, and let his forelock hangdown.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسحاق بن منصور، عن إبراهيم بن سعد، عن ابن إسحاق، عن يحيى بن عباد، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت كنت أفرق خلف يافوخ رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ثم أسدل ناصيته ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: “A man of Paradise will have a garment of silk in Hell.”

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: Humran the freed slave of 'Uthman bin 'Affan said:                     "I saw 'Uthman bin 'Affan sitting in Maqa'id. He called for water and he performed ablution, the he said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah sitting in this place where I am sitting, performing ablution as I have done. Then he said: "Whoever performs ablution as I have done, his previous sins will be forgiven." And the Messenger of Allah said: "And do not be conceited (due to this great virtue)." (Sahih)Another chain with similar wording.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا الأوزاعي، حدثنا يحيى بن أبي كثير، حدثني محمد بن إبراهيم، حدثني شقيق بن سلمة، حدثني حمران، مولى عثمان بن عفان قال رأيت عثمان بن عفان قاعدا في المقاعد فدعا بوضوء فتوضأ ثم قال رأيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في مقعدي هذا توضأ مثل وضوئي هذا ثم قال ‏"‏ من توضأ مثل وضوئي هذا غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ولا تغتروا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: “I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: 'No fault does anyone commit which is more pleasing to Allah than giving of one’s property for His sake.’”
label: partial

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     (Allah (SWT) says:) “I am the opponent of three on the Day of Resurrection, and if I am someone's opponent I will defeat him: A man who makes promises in My Name, then proves treacherous; a man who sells a free man and consumes his price; and a man who hires a worker, makes use to him, then does not give him his wages.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا يحيى بن سليم، عن إسماعيل بن أمية، عن سعيد بن أبي سعيد المقبري، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ثلاثة أنا خصمهم يوم القيامة ومن كنت خصمه خصمته يوم القيامة رجل أعطى بي ثم غدر ورجل باع حرا فأكل ثمنه ورجل استأجر أجيرا فاستوفى منه ولم يوفه أجره ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira regarding a man who pawned his garment with a Jew, then he did not return it to take possession of it, so the Jew took it and sold it. He said: “He is an adulterer.”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Tufail bin Ubayy bin Ka’b that his father said:                     “TheMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray facing the trunk of a date-palmtree when the mosque was still a hut, and he used to deliver thesermon leaning on that trunk. A man from among his Companions said:‘Would you like us to make you something upon which you can standonFridays so that the people will be able to see you and hear yoursermon?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ So he made three steps for him, as apulpit.When they put the pulpit in place, they put it in the placewhere itstands now. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wanted tostand on thepulpit, he passed by the tree trunk from which he usedto deliver thesermon, and when he went beyond the trunk, it moanedand split andcracked. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came down when heheard thevoice of the trunk, and rubbed it with his hand until itfell silent.Then he went back to the pulpit and when he prayed, heprayed facingit. When the mosque was knocked down (for renovation)and (thepillars, etc.) were changed, Ubayy bin Ka’b took thattrunk and keptit in his house until it became very old and thetermites consumed itand it became grains of dust.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسماعيل بن عبد الله الرقي، حدثنا عبيد الله بن عمرو الرقي، عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل، عن الطفيل بن أبى بن كعب، عن أبيه، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يصلي إلى جذع إذ كان المسجد عريشا وكان يخطب إلى ذلك الجذع فقال رجل من أصحابه هل لك أن نجعل لك شيئا تقوم عليه يوم الجمعة حتى يراك الناس وتسمعهم خطبتك قال ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فصنع له ثلاث درجات فهي التي على المنبر فلما وضع المنبر وضعوه في موضعه الذي هو فيه فلما أراد رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن يقوم إلى المنبر مر إلى الجذع الذي كان يخطب إليه فلما جاوز الجذع خار حتى تصدع وانشق فنزل رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  لما سمع صوت الجذع فمسحه بيده حتى سكن ثم رجع إلى المنبر فكان إذا صلى صلى إليه فلما هدم المسجد وغير أخذ ذلك الجذع أبى بن كعب وكان عنده في بيته حتى بلي فأكلته الأرضة وعاد رفاتا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “A man prayed Asr prayer with his hand on his heart while he was praying.” He then asked him about it and he replied, "He was trying to strengthen the faith in his heart." Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade this.

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah and Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet (ﷺ)delayed Tawafuz-Ziyarah until nighttime.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بكر بن خلف أبو بشر، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، حدثنا سفيان، حدثني محمد بن طارق، عن طاوس، وأبو الزبير، عن عائشة، وابن، عباس أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أخر طواف الزيارة إلى الليل ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about his Hajj (pilgrimage) to Allah's House, so Jaaber said, "I circumambulated the Kaaba seven times and prayed two Rakats in between each time." Then Jabir recited: “Indeed, you will not make prohibited access unto them nor enter it with respect.” So I asked him about his Tawaf (circumambulation) of Allah’s House. He replied that he had done so as described above.

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Rafi' that :                     Abu Hurairah was met by the Prophet in one of the streets of Al-Madinah when he was in a state of sexual impurity, so he slipped away. The Prophet missed him, so when he came (later on), he said: 'Where were you O Abu Hurairah?' He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, you met me when I was in a state of sexual impurity, and I did not want to sit with you until I had a bath. The Messenger of Allah said: 'The believer does not become impure.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن حميد، عن بكر بن عبد الله، عن أبي رافع، عن أبي هريرة، أنه لقيه النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في طريق من طرق المدينة وهو جنب فانسل ففقده النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فلما جاء قال ‏"‏ أين كنت يا أبا هريرة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال يا رسول الله لقيتني وأنا جنب فكرهت أن أجالسك حتى أغتسل ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ المؤمن لا ينجس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed ashen (i.e., with his hands on his ears) and then said, “I am praying.” So Jaafar told him to pray without doing so because Allah says: "And when you stand up for prayer, turn away from them."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Wa’il bin Hujr said:                      “I saw the Prophet (ﷺ)making a circle with his thumb and middle finger, and raising the onenext to it (the index finger), supplicating with it during theTashah-hud.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا عبد الله بن إدريس، عن عاصم بن كليب، عن أبيه، عن وائل بن حجر، قال رأيت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قد حلق الإبهام والوسطى ورفع التي تليهما يدعو بها في التشهد ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi ’Auf said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer with a small number of rak'ahs (units) in his house, and then he came out and offered the Maghrib prayer while standing. So Allah blessed him.” Then someone asked me about it, so I replied, "He did not make up an action for himself; rather, he performed what was established by our Prophet – may Allah bless him and grant him peace– in Asr."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'O Allah! Strengthen Islam with 'Umar bin Khattab in particular.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبيد أبو عبيد المديني، حدثنا عبد الملك بن الماجشون، حدثني الزنجي بن خالد، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ اللهم أعز الإسلام بعمر بن الخطاب خاصة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed as he pleased; so he said to him, “He is not from me.” Then I heard it from Ibn Abi Hatim regarding a man who used to pray at night and then would sleep for three quarters of the night; so he said to him, "He is not from me." And I also heard it from Abu Huraira that Jaafir bin Jabr said: “If anyone prayed as he pleased, let him be disgraced.”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:                      “Allah enjoined the prayer uponthe tongue of your Prophet (ﷺ): Four Rak’ah while a resident andtwoRak’ah when traveling.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب، وجبارة بن المغلس، قالا حدثنا أبو عوانة، عن بكير بن الأخنس، عن مجاهد، عن ابن عباس، قال افترض الله الصلاة على لسان نبيكم  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في الحضر أربعا وفي السفر ركعتين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “I asked Jaafir bin Sumrad about praying Ashura (the tenth of Muharram) and he replied, 'Yes, there is no objection in it.’” Then Allah revealed this verse: "Indeed, Laylat al-Qadr among the days; whoever brings one qirat [of Qur’an] from its aya – thereof, verily he will be given reward like as if he had ten of these or thirty. And five times more.” (Surah Al Qadr 97:3–4). So I asked Jaafir about this and he said to me, “Do you think that we should not pray Ashura because of the verse?” Then Allah revealed this ayah: "Saying, ‘O you who have believed! Fear your Lord – indeed, He is ever-increasing [in greatness] and never does He delay in rewarding those who do good among you. That you may remember.'" (Surah Al Ma’idah 5:64). So I asked Jaafir about this verse and he said to me “Do you think that we should not pray Ashura because of the verse?” Then Allah revealed this ayah: "Indeed, Laylat al-Qadr among the days; whoever brings one qirat [of Qur’an] from its aya – thereof, verily he will be given

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Salim bin ‘Abdullah that his father said:                      “TheMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not touch the corners of the Ka’bahapartfrom the Black Corner (i.e., the corner where the Black Stoneis) andthe one that is next to it facing the houses of Banu Jumah(i.e., theYemenite Corner).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح المصري، حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، عن سالم بن عبد الله، عن أبيه، قال لم يكن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يستلم من أركان البيت إلا الركن الأسود والذي يليه من نحو دور الجمحيين ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about his (Jaaber's) Hajj ritual, so Jaaber said to him, "I used to perform Tawaf seven times around the Kaaba while holding a stone in my hand and reciting verses from the Book of Allah. Then I would proceed towards Maqam Ibrahim and recite there." He further stated that he did this during his first three hajj journeys.

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sa’eed said:                     “The Prophet used to give us dates from the collection (mixed) [1]  dates, and we would exchange them for dates that were better, and we add to the price. [2] The Messenger of Allah said: ‘It is not right to give one Sa of dates for two Sa, nor one Dirham for two Dirham. A Dirham for a Dirham and a Dinar for a Dinar is allowed: the only difference between them is in weight (i.e., the weight must be equal.)’” Sahih
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن محمد بن عمرو، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي سعيد، قال كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يرزقنا تمرا من تمر الجمع فنستبدل به تمرا هو أطيب منه ونزيد في السعر فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا يصلح صاع تمر بصاعين ولا درهم بدرهمين والدرهم بالدرهم والدينار بالدينار لا فضل بينهما إلا وزنا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: “There is no riba [interest] except in permissible transactions.”

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Asid bin Abu Asid, from Musa bin Abu Musa Ash’ari,from his father that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “The deceased ispunished for the weeping of the living. If they say: ‘O mystrength, O he who clothed us, O my help, O my rock,’ and so on, heis rebuked and it is said: ‘Were you really like that? Were youreally like that?’” Asid said: "I said: 'Subhan-Allah! Allah says: "And no bearer of burdens shall another's burden (35:18)." He said: "Woe to you, I tell you that Abu Musa narrated to me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and you think that Abu Musa was telling lies about the Prophet (ﷺ)? Or do you think that I am telling lies about Abu Musa?"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن حميد بن كاسب، حدثنا عبد العزيز بن محمد الدراوردي، حدثنا أسيد بن أبي أسيد، عن موسى بن أبي موسى الأشعري، عن أبيه، ‏.‏ أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ الميت يعذب ببكاء الحى إذا قالوا واعضداه واكاسياه ‏.‏ واناصراه واجبلاه ونحو هذا - يتعتع ويقال أنت كذلك أنت كذلك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أسيد فقلت سبحان الله إن الله يقول ‏{ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى }‏ ‏.‏ قال ويحك أحدثك أن أبا موسى حدثني عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فترى أن أبا موسى كذب على النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أو ترى أني كذبت على أبي موسى
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Angari said to him: “When a person dies among you, one of your brothers should say (to others): 'Do come and pray for this deceased.' And when they came, you should recite with them. Then you should lead them in the prayer.”

Then he added: "And if there was no such thing as ‘Ash-Shafa’a,’ then I would have said to my brother: ‘Go and call people to him.’"

chapter: Chapters on Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri said:                      “The Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) forbade tipping up water skins in order to drink fromtheirmouths.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح، حدثنا ابن وهب، عن يونس، عن ابن شهاب، عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن اختناث الأسقية أن يشرب من أفواهها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who drinks wine and then prays Asharah (the daily prayers), so Jaafar said, “He is not considered to have committed shirk.”

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ma’dan bin Abu Talhah Al-Ya’muri that ‘Umar binKhattab stood up one Friday delivering a sermon. He praised andglorified Allah, then he said:                      “O people, you eat two plants whichIdo not regard as anything but offensive: This garlic and theseonions.At the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I would see aman, if thesmell (of these vegetables) was found on him, being takenby the handand led out to Baqi’ (graveyard). Whoever must eatthem, let him cookthem to death.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن سالم بن أبي الجعد الغطفاني، عن معدان بن أبي طلحة اليعمري، أن عمر بن الخطاب، قام يوم الجمعة خطيبا فحمد الله وأثنى عليه ثم قال يا أيها الناس إنكم تأكلون شجرتين لا أراهما إلا خبيثتين هذا الثوم وهذا البصل ولقد كنت أرى الرجل على عهد رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يوجد ريحه منه فيؤخذ بيده حتى يخرج به إلى البقيع فمن كان آكلهما لا بد فليمتهما طبخا ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awliyia said to him: “If anyone offered you a bowl of milk or water from an animal which had been slaughtered for Allah, then accept it.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Zaid bin Arqam said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said to 'Ali, Fatimah, Hasan and Husain: 'I am peace for those with whom you make peace, and I am war for those with whom you make war.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الحسن بن علي الخلال، وعلي بن المنذر، قالا حدثنا أبو غسان، حدثنا أسباط بن نصر، عن السدي، عن صبيح، مولى أم سلمة عن زيد بن أرقم، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  لعلي وفاطمة والحسن والحسين ‏"‏ أنا سلم لمن سالمتم وحرب لمن حاربتم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say all of its prescribed Ruku' (prostrations) and stand up for Sujud.” Then he recited: "So establish prayers with our Lord fearfully, With remembrance of Him."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr that the Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) said:                      “The first signs to appear will be at the risingof the sun from the west and the emergence of the Beast to thepeople, at forenoon.’”'Abdullah said: "Whichever of them appears first, the other will come soon after." 'Abdullah said: "I do not think it will be anything other than the sun rising from the west."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي حيان التيمي، عن أبي زرعة بن عمرو بن جرير، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أول الآيات خروجا طلوع الشمس من مغربها وخروج الدابة على الناس ضحى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال عبد الله فأيتهما ما خرجت قبل الأخرى فالأخرى منها قريب ‏.‏ قال عبد الله ولا أظنها إلا طلوع الشمس من مغربها ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Adiy: I asked Abu Hurairah about a dream which I saw in my sleep that I was leading an army; they were wearing green garments, and they were victorious. He said, “It is not sinful to have such dreams.” Then he added, "Verily, the Prophet (peace be upon him) has stated: ‘When any of you has a dream should say: *La hawla wala quwwata illa billah*’ [There is no power nor strength except by God]. And if it was good then do not increase in gratitude to Allah and do not ascribe to Him. But if it was bad, then he should seek refuge with Allah from the evil of Satan.”

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn`Abbas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “Whoever you find doing the action of the people of Lut, kill the one who does it, and the one to whom it is done.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، وأبو بكر بن خلاد قالا حدثنا عبد العزيز بن محمد، عن عمرو بن أبي عمرو، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من وجدتموه يعمل عمل قوم لوط فاقتلوا الفاعل والمفعول به ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him: “Verily, Allah has ordained a punishment for every sin; so when you are asked about it, tell them that there is no escape from the decree of Allah.” Then he recited: "And those who defy Our Ayat – they will enter into a Gate other than that through which they came. And Shayatin would then guide their hands and incline them to evil."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from ‘Abdullah bin ‘Amr bin ‘As that theMessenger ofAllah (ﷺ) said:                      “When the treasures of Persia andRome are openedfor you, what kind of people will you be?”‘Abdur-Rahman bin ‘Awfsaid: “We will say what Allah hascommanded us to say.” The Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) said: “Orsomething other than that. You will competewith one another, thenyou will envy one another, then you will turnyour backs on oneanother, then you will hate one another, orsomething like that. Thenyou will go to the poor among the Muhajirunand appoint some of themas leaders of others.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن سواد المصري، أخبرني عبد الله بن وهب، أنبأنا عمرو بن الحارث، أن بكر بن سوادة، حدثه أن يزيد بن رباح حدثه عن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أنه قال ‏"‏ إذا فتحت عليكم خزائن فارس والروم أى قوم أنتم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال عبد الرحمن بن عوف نقول كما أمرنا الله ‏.‏ قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أو غير ذلك تتنافسون ثم تتحاسدون ثم تتدابرون ثم تتباغضون أو نحو ذلك ثم تنطلقون في مساكين المهاجرين فتجعلون بعضهم على رقاب بعض ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira – may Allah grant him relief - about a dream which came to me in which I saw my mother eating with the Prophet (peace be upon him) in Paradise, and he was giving her dates from his hand.

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik  said:                     "Whenever the Prophet(ﷺ) met a man, he would speak to him, and would not tun away until he (the other man) was the one who turned away. And if he shook hands with him, he would not withdraw his hand until he (the other man) withdrew his hand. And he was never seen sitting with his knees ahead of the knees of the one who was sitting next to him."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن أبي يحيى الطويل، - رجل من أهل الكوفة - عن زيد العمي، عن أنس بن مالك، قال كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا لقي الرجل فكلمه لم يصرف وجهه عنه حتى يكون هو الذي ينصرف وإذا صافحه لم ينزع يده من يده حتى يكون هو الذي ينزعها ولم ير متقدما بركبتيه جليسا له قط ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Angari said to him: “A man should always speak with kindness.” Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said, "Indeed, a person who speaks kindly is like one whose feet are raised from Jannah."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Ammar bin Yasir that:                     The Messenger of Allah said: "Part of the Fitrah is rinsing out the mouth, rinsing out the nostrils, using the tooth stick, trimming the mustache, clipping the nails, plucking the armpit hairs, shaving the pubic hairs, washing the joints, washing the private parts and circumcision.'" (Da'if)Another chain with similar wording.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سهل بن أبي سهل، ومحمد بن يحيى، قالا حدثنا أبو الوليد، حدثنا حماد، عن علي بن زيد، عن سلمة بن محمد بن عمار بن ياسر، عن عمار بن ياسر، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من الفطرة المضمضة والاستنشاق والسواك وقص الشارب وتقليم الأظفار ونتف الإبط والاستحداد وغسل البراجم والانتضاح والاختتان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: “I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whoever performs Ghusl (ritual bath) on Fridays of one who is sick then God will forgive his past sins.’”

ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Mu'awiyah bin Qurrah that his father said:                     “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me to a man who had married his father's wife after he died, to strike his neck (execute him) and confiscate his wealth.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الرحمن ابن أخي الحسين الجعفي، حدثنا يوسف بن منازل التيمي، حدثنا عبد الله بن إدريس، عن خالد بن أبي كريمة، عن معاوية بن قرة، عن أبيه، قال بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى رجل تزوج امرأة أبيه أن أضرب عنقه وأصفي ماله ‏.‏

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said:                      “Sulaik Ghatafanienteredthe mosque when the Prophet (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon.He said:‘Have you prayed?’ He said: ‘No.’ He said: ‘Then performtwoRak’ah.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عمرو بن دينار، سمع جابرا، وأبو الزبير، سمع جابر بن عبد الله، قال دخل سليك الغطفاني المسجد والنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يخطب ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ أصليت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال لا ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فصل ركعتين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وأما عمرو فلم يذكر سليكا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer in his house with his family, then he went out and they were still praying; so he left them until the end of their prayers.” Then Jabir bin Abdullah came forward and said: "If a person prays Ashura (Asr) while his parents are present, or any member of his household is present, he should not leave them till they finish."

chapter: The Book of the Adhan and the Sunnah Regarding It - كتاب الأذان والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When you hear the call (to prayer), say what the Mu'adh-dhin says.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، وأبو بكر بن أبي شيبة قالا حدثنا زيد بن الحباب، عن مالك بن أنس، عن الزهري، عن عطاء بن يزيد الليثي، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا سمعتم النداء فقولوا كما يقول المؤذن ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed while looking at his hand; so Jaafar said to him, "He has done wrong." Then Ibn Abbas came and said, “If he was doing this out of forgetfulness then it is permissible.”

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Anas that some people from ‘Urainah came to theMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) but they were averse to the climate ofAl-Madinah. He (ﷺ) said:                      “Why don’t you go out to a flock ofcamels ofours, and drink their milk and urine.” And they did that.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا نصر بن علي الجهضمي، حدثنا عبد الوهاب، حدثنا حميد، عن أنس، أن ناسا، من عرينة قدموا على رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فاجتووا المدينة فقال  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لو خرجتم إلى ذود لنا فشربتم من ألبانها وأبوالها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ففعلوا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'rub: I asked Abu Huraira – may Allah be pleased with him - about a man who was afflicted with a painful swelling in his abdomen; he said to him, “Give it an oil and pray for healing.” He then inquired again, saying, "And what if the pain increased?" He replied, "Then give him more of that same oil." Then I asked again, saying, "What if the pain continued increasing?” He said: “You should seek a physician (Shaykh).”

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Umar that he used to forbid silk and brocadeexceptthat which was like that, then he gestured with his finger,then hissecond finger, then his third, then his fourth,* and said:                     “TheMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to forbid that to us.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا حفص بن غياث، عن عاصم الأحول، عن أبي عثمان، عن عمر، أنه كان ينهى عن الحرير، والديباج، إلا ما كان هكذا ثم أشار بإصبعه ثم الثانية ثم الثالثة ثم الرابعة وقال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ينهانا عنه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: “There should be no killing of a man except by his brother; nor injuring of eyes except by another eye.” Then he said, "As for the fighting in Jihad, it is only until we establish prayer and justice."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdullah bin Salam said:                      “I said, when theMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting: ‘We find in the Book of Allahthat on Friday there is an hour when no believing slave performsprayer and asks Allah for anything at that time, but Allah willfulfill his need.’” ‘Abdullah said: “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)pointed to me, saying: ‘Or some part of an hour.’ I said:‘you areright, or some part of an hour.’ I said: ‘What time isthat?’ He said:‘It is the last hours of the day.’ I said: ‘Itis not the time of theprayer?’ He said: ‘Yes (it is so), when abelieving slave performsprayer and then sits with nothing but heprayer keeping him, he isstill in a state of prayer.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم الدمشقي، حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، عن الضحاك بن عثمان، عن أبي النضر، عن أبي سلمة، عن عبد الله بن سلام، قال قلت ورسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  جالس إنا لنجد في كتاب الله في يوم الجمعة ساعة لا يوافقها عبد مؤمن يصلي يسأل الله فيها شيئا إلا قضى له حاجته ‏.‏ قال عبد الله فأشار إلى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أو بعض ساعة ‏.‏ فقلت صدقت أو بعض ساعة ‏.‏ قلت أى ساعة هي قال ‏"‏ هي آخر ساعة من ساعات النهار ‏"‏ قلت إنها ليست ساعة صلاة ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ بلى إن العبد المؤمن إذا صلى ثم جلس لا يحبسه إلا الصلاة فهو في صلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, “It is recommended that a person should wipe over his/her head with one hand while wiping over his/her body with another when praying in wudu.”

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Ghutaif Al-Hudhali said:                     "I was listening to 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Khattab in the mosque, and when the time for prayer came, he got up, performed ablution, and offered prayer, then he went back to where he had been sitting. When the time for 'Asr (Afternnon prayer) came, he got up, performed ablution, and offered prayer, then he went back to where he had been sitting. When the time for Maghrib (Sunset prayer) came, he got up, performed ablution, and offered prayer, then he went back to where he had been sitting. I said: 'May Allah improve you (i.e., your condition) Is it obligatory or Sunnah to perform ablution for every prayer?' He said: 'Did you notice that?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'No (it is not obligatory). If I perform ablution for Morning prayer I can perform all of the prayers with this ablution, so as long as I do not get impure. But I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "Whoever performs ablution while he is pure, he will have ten merits." So I wanted to earn the merits.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن يزيد المقرئ، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن زياد، عن أبي غطيف الهذلي، قال سمعت عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب، في مجلسه في المسجد فلما حضرت الصلاة قام فتوضأ وصلى ثم عاد إلى مجلسه فلما حضرت العصر قام فتوضأ وصلى ثم عاد إلى مجلسه فلما حضرت المغرب قام فتوضأ وصلى ثم عاد إلى مجلسه فقلت أصلحك الله أفريضة أم سنة الوضوء عند كل صلاة قال أو فطنت إلى وإلى هذا مني فقلت نعم ‏.‏ فقال لا لو توضأت لصلاة الصبح لصليت به الصلوات كلها ما لم أحدث ولكني سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ من توضأ على كل طهر فله عشر حسنات ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وإنما رغبت في الحسنات ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prays asites (i.e., performs his prayers with one hand) and then wipes over his face, but does not wipe over his arms; so Jaafar said to him, “He is a disbeliever.” Then I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked ‘Abdullah bin Abi’r-Rawsan about the same thing. He replied: "If he performs ablution with one hand and wipes his face but does not wipe over his arms then it is as if he has not performed Ablution."

llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Adiy: I asked Abu Hurairah about the one who makes an intention to perform Jihad and then does something that is not part of it (i.e., he doesn't follow proper procedure). He said, "He has performed Jihad."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abbas bin 'Abdul-Muttalib said:                     "We used to come across groups of Quraish who would be talking, but they would stop talking (when we approached). We mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'What is the matter with people who talk, then when they see a man from my family they stop talking? By Allah, faith will not enter a person's heart until he loves them for the sake of Allah and because of their closeness to me.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن طريف، حدثنا محمد بن فضيل، حدثنا الأعمش، عن أبي سبرة النخعي، عن محمد بن كعب القرظي، عن العباس بن عبد المطلب، قال كنا نلقى النفر من قريش وهم يتحدثون فيقطعون حديثهم فذكرنا ذلك لرسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ ما بال أقوام يتحدثون فإذا رأوا الرجل من أهل بيتي قطعوا حديثهم والله لا يدخل قلب رجل الإيمان حتى يحبهم لله ولقرابتهم مني ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say all of its prescribed Ruku' (prostrations) and stand up for Sujud.”

ground_truth_en: It was narrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “If the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a cloud that looked as if it was bringing rain, the color of his face would change, and he would go in and out and walk to and fro. Then, if it rained, he would feel relieved.” ‘Aishah mentioned to him what she had seen him do, and he said: “How do you know? He appealed to the Prophet (ﷺ) who ordered that the Diyah be paid. The man said: “O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I want retaliation.” He said: “Take the compensation and may Allah bless you therein.” And he did not rule that he be allowed retaliation.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، وعمار بن خالد الواسطي، حدثنا أبو بكر بن عياش، عن دهثم بن قران، حدثني نمران بن جارية، عن أبيه، أن رجلا، ضرب رجلا على ساعده بالسيف فقطعها من غير مفصل فاستعدى عليه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأمر له بالدية فقال يا رسول الله إني أريد القصاص ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ خذ الدية بارك الله لك فيها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ولم يقض له بالقصاص ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ bin al-Harba’: I asked Abu Huraira: “Is a man permitted to take compensation from his brother for an injury he inflicted upon him?” He said, "Yes." I then asked, "If the injured person refused it?" He replied, "He should be given half of what was due to him.”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Ifyou sayto your companions: ‘Be quiet’ on a Friday while the Imam isdelivering the sermon, you have engaged in Laghw (idle talk orbehaviour).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا شبابة بن سوار، عن ابن أبي ذئب، عن الزهري، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي هريرة، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ إذا قلت لصاحبك أنصت يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب فقد لغوت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaafar bin Aboahurairah about praying behind a man who was wearing musk and had not purified himself from it, and he said, 'You should pray behind him.' Then I asked him again, and he repeated his answer. So I went to Jafare’s house and told him of this conversation; so Jaafar said, ‘If the musk has been washed off with water, you may pray behind him.’"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: Sa'eed bin Musayyab narrated that Abu Hurairah used to say:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: Allah will seize the earth on the Day of Ressurection, and He will roll up the heavens in his Right Hand, then He will say, "I am the Sovereign. Where are the kings of the earth?'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، ويونس بن عبد الأعلى، قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، حدثني سعيد بن المسيب، أن أبا هريرة، كان يقول قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ يقبض الله الأرض يوم القيامة ويطوي السماء بيمينه ثم يقول أنا الملك أين ملوك الأرض ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed as he pleased; so he said to him, “He is not from me.” Then I heard it from Ibn Abi Hatim regarding a person who would pray at night and then sleep during the day. He was also told: "You are not of my Ummah."

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Adi bin Thabit, from his father, from hisgrandfather, that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Spitting, blowing one’snose, menstruating and drowsiness during the prayer are from Satan.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا الفضل بن دكين، عن شريك، عن أبي اليقظان، عن عدي بن ثابت، عن أبيه، عن جده، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ البزاق والمخاط والحيض والنعاس في الصلاة من الشيطان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer in his house with his family, then he went out and they were still praying; so he left them until the end of their prayers.” Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade this. He said, "Do not do that for you are better than those who pray."

ground_truth_en: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:                     "It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how will you recognize those whom you have not seen of your Ummah?' He said: 'From the blazes of their foreheads and feet, like horses with black and white traces (which make them distinct from others) which are the traces of ablution.'" ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى النيسابوري، حدثنا أبو الوليد، هشام بن عبد الملك حدثنا حماد، عن عاصم، عن زر بن حبيش، أن عبد الله بن مسعود، قال قيل يا رسول الله كيف تعرف من لم تر من أمتك قال ‏"‏ غر محجلون بلق من آثار الطهور ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: “I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whoever performs Ghusl (ritual bath) on Fridays of one who is sick, it will expiate for his past sins.’”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Aishah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) usedtosay Taslim after every two Rak’ah, and he would perform Witr withone Rak’ah.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا شبابة، عن ابن أبي ذئب، عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يسلم في كل ثنتين ويوتر بواحدة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer with his hand on his chest while he was praying it, and then Allah revealed a verse in the Book regarding this. So you should pray as others pray.” Then Uthaina bin Salih asked him: "Do I make my hands touch my sides when I pray?" He said, “Yes."

chapter: The Chapters on Rulings - كتاب الأحكام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Jabir bin 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     'Whoever swears a false oath near this pulpit of mine, let him take his place in Hell, even if it is for a green twig.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن رافع، حدثنا مروان بن معاوية، ح وحدثنا أحمد بن ثابت الجحدري، حدثنا صفوان بن عيسى، قالا حدثنا هاشم بن هاشم، عن عبد الله بن نسطاس، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من حلف بيمين آثمة عند منبري هذا فليتبوأ مقعده من النار ولو على سواك أخضر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade praying Ashura with flags and music.” Then he added, "And a man asked him, 'Is it not permissible for us to pray on the day of Asyurah as we prayed on Fridays?' The Messenger of Allah (may prayers and peace be upon him) said: ‘No, but there is no harm in fasting.’”

chapter: The Book of the Prayer - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abbas bin 'Abdul-Muttalib said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'My Ummah will continue to adhere to the Fitrah so long as they do not delay the Maghrib until the stars have come out." (Hasan)Abu 'Abdullah bin Majah said: I heard Muhammed bin Yahya saying: 'The people in Baghdad were confused in narrating this Hadith. Abu Bakr Al-A'yan and I went to 'Awwam bin 'Abbad bin 'Awwam and he brought out to us the book of his father, and this Hadith was in it.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، حدثنا إبراهيم بن موسى، أنبأنا عباد بن العوام، عن عمر بن إبراهيم، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن الأحنف بن قيس، عن العباس بن عبد المطلب، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا تزال أمتي على الفطرة ما لم يؤخروا المغرب حتى تشتبك النجوم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الله بن ماجه سمعت محمد بن يحيى يقول اضطرب الناس في هذا الحديث ببغداد فذهبت أنا وأبو بكر الأعين إلى العوام بن عباد بن العوام فأخرج إلينا أصل أبيه فإذا الحديث فيه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Umair bin Halafah: I heard Abu Huraira saying, "It is recommended that a person should perform his prayers in congregation (Jama’a) even if he was alone at home." Then Ibn Abbas said to him, “Do you mean someone who has no companion?” He replied, “Yes.”

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Ala bin ‘Abdur-Rahman that his father said:                      “Isaid to Abu Sa’eed: ‘Did you hear anything from the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) concerning the lower wrap?’ He said: ‘Yes. I heardthe Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) say: ‘The lower wrap of the believershould come tomid-calf, but there is no sin on him if it comesbetween that pointand the ankle. But whatever is lower than theankle is in the Fire.’And he said three times: ‘Allah will notlook at the one who lets hislower wrap drag out of vanity.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن العلاء بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، قال قلت لأبي سعيد هل سمعت من، رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  شيئا في الإزار قال نعم سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ إزرة المؤمن إلى أنصاف ساقيه لا جناح عليه ما بينه وبين الكعبين وما أسفل من الكعبين في النار ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يقول ثلاثا ‏"‏ لا ينظر الله إلى من جر إزاره بطرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: “A man of Paradise will have a garment of silk in Hell.”

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) told himto seat ‘Aishah behind him on his riding animal, and perform ‘Umrahwith her from Tan’im.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو إسحاق الشافعي إبراهيم بن محمد بن العباس بن عثمان بن شافع قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عمرو بن دينار، أخبرني عمرو بن أوس، حدثني عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكر، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمره أن يردف عائشة فيعمرها من التنعيم ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) about what was meant by “Al-‘Umrah” in relation to Hajj, and he said: "It is a lesser pilgrimage." Then Jabir recited: “So whoever performs Umrah then does not perform Tawaf [circumambulation] for the obligatory Hajj, it becomes an ‘Umrah.”

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet (ﷺ) distributed thewarspoils on the Day of Khaibar, giving three shares to the horseman,two shares for the horse, and one share for the man.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أسهم يوم خيبر للفارس ثلاثة أسهم للفرس سهمان وللرجل سهم ‏.‏

He said to him, “He is not from the people of true faith.” Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: "As for those who pray at home and do not offer prayers with their communities, they are like dead folks; their eyes are present but their hearts are absent."

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Musa that the Messenger of Allah said:                     'Whoever has a slave woman and teaches her good manners and educates her, then sets her free and marries her, will have two rewards. Any man from among the People of the Book who believed in his Prophet and believed in Muhammad will have two rewards. Any slave who does his duty towards Allah and towards his masters will have two rewards.” (Sahih)(one of the narrators) Salih said: “Sha'bi said: 'I have given this (Hadith) to you for little effort on your part. A rider would travel to Al-Madinah for less than this.'  ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد أبو سعيد الأشج، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن صالح بن صالح بن حى، عن الشعبي، عن أبي بردة، عن أبي موسى، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من كانت له جارية فأدبها فأحسن أدبها وعلمها فأحسن تعليمها ثم أعتقها وتزوجها فله أجران وأيما رجل من أهل الكتاب آمن بنبيه وآمن بمحمد فله أجران وأيما عبد مملوك أدى حق الله عليه وحق مواليه فله أجران ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال صالح قال الشعبي قد أعطيتكها بغير شىء ‏.‏ إن كان الراكب ليركب فيما دونها إلى المدينة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who married a woman because of her beauty; so Jaafar said, “He has taken a mahr (dowry) from her.” Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade marrying women for their beauty.
