chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     ‘When you see the new crescent, fast, and when you see it, stopfasting. If it is cloudy then calculate it (as thirty days).” Ibn‘Umar used to fast one day before the new crescent was seen.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو مروان، محمد بن عثمان العثماني حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد، عن الزهري، عن سالم بن عبد الله، عن ابن عمر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا رأيتم الهلال فصوموا وإذا رأيتموه فأفطروا ‏.‏ فإن غم عليكم فاقدروا له ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال وكان ابن عمر يصوم قبل الهلال بيوم ‏.‏

Then I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: “Fasting consecutively is an atonement for sin.”

ground_truth_en: Maimunah,the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ)used toperform prayer when I was opposite to him, and his garmentwouldsometimes touch me when he prostrated.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عباد بن العوام، عن الشيباني، عن عبد الله بن شداد، قال حدثتني ميمونة، زوج النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قالت كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يصلي وأنا بحذائه وربما أصابني ثوبه إذا سجد ‏.‏

I replied, "Yes, but you should not do it continuously. Rather, pray as the Prophet’s companions used to pray."

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “When a meal is served, a man should not stand up until it isremoved, and he should not take his hand away, even if he is full,until the people have finished. And let him continue eating.* For aman may make his companion shy, causing him to withhold his hand, andperhaps he has a need for the food.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن خلف العسقلاني، حدثنا عبيد الله، أنبأنا عبد الأعلى، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن ابن عمر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا وضعت المائدة فلا يقوم رجل حتى ترفع المائدة ولا يرفع يده وإن شبع حتى يفرغ القوم وليعذر فإن الرجل يخجل جليسه فيقبض يده وعسى أن يكون له في الطعام حاجة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who eats food while reciting verses of the Book (of Allah), then his reward is doubled, and another asks him, “Why do you think so?” He replied, "Because it is like a soldier fighting in Jihad.”

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو بن رافع، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن عبد العزيز بن صهيب، عن أنس بن مالك، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا دخل الخلاء قال ‏"‏ أعوذ بالله من الخبث والخبائث ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: “I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: 'No fault does anyone commit but forgiveness except that of a man who marries a widow for charity.’”

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn Shihab, from Salim bin Abdullah, from his father, from the Messenger of Allah:                     Salim said: “My father read to me a letter that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had written about Sadaqat before Allah caused him to pass away. I read in it: 'For forty sheep, one sheep, up to one hundred and twenty. If there is more than that - even one - then two sheep, up to two hundred, If there is one more than that - even one = then three sheep, up to three hundred. If there are many sheep, then for each hundred, one sheep.' And I read in it: 'Separate flocks should not be combined, and a combined flock should not be separated.' And I read in it: 'And a male goat should not be taken for Sadaqah, nor a decrepit nor defective animal.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بكر بن خلف، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، حدثنا سليمان بن كثير، حدثنا ابن شهاب، عن سالم بن عبد الله، عن أبيه، عن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال أقرأني سالم كتابا كتبه رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في الصدقات قبل أن يتوفاه الله فوجدت فيه ‏"‏ في أربعين شاة شاة إلى عشرين ومائة فإذا زادت واحدة ففيها شاتان إلى مائتين فإذا زادت واحدة ففيها ثلاث شياه إلى ثلاثمائة فإذا كثرت ففي كل مائة شاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ووجدت فيه ‏"‏ لا يجمع بين متفرق ولا يفرق بين مجتمع ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ووجدت فيه ‏"‏ لا يؤخذ في الصدقة تيس ولا هرمة ولا ذات عوار ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “Whoever gives Zakat from his property to one who is entitled to it, then Allah will grant him a house in Paradise.”

chapter: Chapters on Medicine - كتاب الطب
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that one of the things that the Prophet(ﷺ)used to say for the sick person, with saliva on his finger(dipped indust), was:                      “Bismillah, turbatu ardina, biriqati ba’dina,liyushfasaqimuna. Bi’dhni Rabbina (In the Name of Allah, the dust ofourland mixed with the saliva of one of us, to cure our sick one bythepermission of our Lord).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا سفيان، عن عبد ربه، عن عمرة، عن عائشة، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كان مما يقول للمريض ببزاقه بإصبعه ‏"‏ بسم الله بتربة أرضنا بريقة بعضنا ليشفى سقيمنا بإذن ربنا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaaber bin Abdullah about a man who had a pain in his side; so Jaaber said, “Give him some honey and black cumin.” He then repeated this three times. Then Ibn Masruq came to him and said, "Did you hear what Jaaber has told you?" I replied, "Yes." And he asked me, "Do you know that the Prophet (peace be upon Him) used to give a man who had pain in his side some honey and black cumin?” So I said, “Indeed, I heard him saying: ‘Give him some honey and black cumin.’”

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:                     “The Muslim is obliged to obey (the ruler) whether he likes itornot, unless he is commanded to commit an act of disobedience. If heis commanded to commit a sin then he should neither listen nor obey.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، ح وحدثنا محمد بن الصباح، وسويد بن سعيد، قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن رجاء المكي، عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ على المرء المسلم الطاعة فيما أحب أو كره إلا أن يؤمر بمعصية فمن أمر بمعصية فلا سمع ولا طاعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “Whoever kills a person intending Jihad, he will not receive an intercession with Allah on that day.”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Jarir bin ‘Abdullah Al-Bajali said:                      “We used tothink that gathering with the family of the deceased and preparingfood was a form of wailing.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، قال حدثنا سعيد بن منصور، حدثنا هشيم، ح وحدثنا شجاع بن مخلد أبو الفضل، قال حدثنا هشيم، عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن قيس بن أبي حازم، عن جرير بن عبد الله البجلي، قال كنا نرى الاجتماع إلى أهل الميت وصنعة الطعام من النياحة ‏.‏

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Anas bin Malik that a man from the tribe of Banu‘Abdul-Ashhal, while (one narrator) ‘Ali bin Muhammad said (hewas) aman from the tribe of Banu ‘Abdullah bin Ka’b, said:                      “Thecavalry ofthe Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) attacked us, so I came to theMessengerof Allah (ﷺ) while he was eating a meal. He said: ‘Comeand eat.’ Isaid: ‘I am fasting.’ He said: ‘Sit down and Iwill tell you aboutfasting. Allah has relieved the traveler of halfof the prayer, and Hehas relieved the traveler, the pregnant, andthe nursing mothers ofthe duty to fast.’ By Allah, the Prophet(ﷺ) said them, both, or oneof them, and now I feel so disappointedthat I had not eaten of thefood of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن أبي هلال، عن عبد الله بن سوادة، عن أنس بن مالك، - رجل من بني عبد الأشهل وقال علي بن محمد من بني عبد الله بن كعب - قال أغارت علينا خيل رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فأتيت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وهو يتغدى فقال ‏"‏ ادن فكل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت إني صائم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ اجلس أحدثك عن الصوم أو الصيام ‏.‏ إن الله عز وجل وضع عن المسافر شطر الصلاة وعن المسافر والحامل والمرضع الصوم أو الصيام ‏"‏ ‏.‏ والله لقد قالهما النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كلتاهما أو إحداهما فيا لهف نفسي فهلا كنت طعمت من طعام رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Umair bin Halafah: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, "Whoever fasts on Tuesday and Thursday with faith and hope will have his past sins forgiven."

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas bin Malik said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his child, his father and all the people.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، ومحمد بن المثنى، قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، قال سمعت قتادة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا يؤمن أحدكم حتى أكون أحب إليه من ولده ووالده والناس أجمعين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say all of its prescribed units.” Then he recited: "So establish prayers with us and glorify the name of your Lord in the morning and evening."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Sa’ib said:                      “Sa’d bin AbuWaqqas came to us when he had become blind. I greeted him with Salamand he said: ‘Who are you?’ So I told him, and he said: ‘Welcome,Oson of my brother. I have heard that you recite Qur’an in abeautifulvoice. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “ThisQur’an wasrevealed with sorrow, so when you recite it, then weep.If you cannotweep then pretend to weep, and make your voicemelodious in recitingit. Whoever does not make his voice melodious,he is not one of us.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن أحمد بن بشير بن ذكوان الدمشقي، حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا أبو رافع، عن ابن أبي مليكة، عن عبد الرحمن بن السائب، قال قدم علينا سعد بن أبي وقاص وقد كف بصره فسلمت عليه فقال من أنت فأخبرته ‏.‏ فقال مرحبا بابن أخي بلغني أنك حسن الصوت بالقرآن سمعت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يقول ‏"‏ إن هذا القرآن نزل بحزن فإذا قرأتموه فابكوا فإن لم تبكوا فتباكوا وتغنوا به فمن لم يتغن به فليس منا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, “It is recommended that a person should wipe over his/her head with one hand while wiping over his/her body with another when praying in wudu.”

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Usamah bin Zaid that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                      “I am not leaving behind me any tribulation that ismoreharmful to men than women.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بشر بن هلال الصواف، حدثنا عبد الوارث بن سعيد، عن سليمان التيمي، ح وحدثنا عمرو بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الله بن المبارك، عن سليمان التيمي، عن أبي عثمان النهدي، عن أسامة بن زيد، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ ما أدع بعدي فتنة أضر على الرجال من النساء ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: I asked Abu Huraira: “What is a trial?” He said, "It is that which makes you feel as if it were impossible to bear." Then he recited: ‘Indeed, We give this test to those who are tested among the believers.’

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Umm ‘Atiyyah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)commanded us to bring them (the women) out on the day of Fitr and theday of Nahr.” Umm ‘Atiyyah said: “We said: ‘What if one ofthem doesnot have an outer covering?’ He said: ‘Let her sistershare her ownouter covering with her.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن هشام بن حسان، عن حفصة بنت سيرين، عن أم عطية، قالت أمرنا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن نخرجهن في يوم الفطر والنحر ‏.‏ قال قالت أم عطية فقلنا أرأيت إحداهن لا يكون لها جلباب قال ‏"‏ فلتلبسها أختها من جلبابها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaafar bin Aboahurairah about praying behind a man who was wearing musk and had not purified himself from it, and he told me, 'You should pray behind him.’”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: ‘Abbasbin Sahl As-Sa’di said:                      “Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid As-Sa’di, Sahlbin Sa’d, and Muhammad bin Maslamah came together and spoke abouttheprayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Abu Humaid said: ‘I amthemost knowledgeable of you about the prayer of the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and said AllahuAkbar,and raised his hands, then he raised them when he said AllahuAkbarfor Ruku’, then he stood up and raised his hands, and stoodstraightuntil every bone had returned to its place.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا أبو عامر، حدثنا فليح بن سليمان، حدثنا عباس بن سهل الساعدي، قال اجتمع أبو حميد وأبو أسيد الساعدي وسهل بن سعد ومحمد بن مسلمة فذكروا صلاة رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال أبو حميد أنا أعلمكم بصلاة رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قام فكبر ورفع يديه ثم رفع حين كبر للركوع ثم قام فرفع يديه واستوى حتى رجع كل عظم إلى موضعه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer with a small number of Rak'ahs (units) in his house, and then he went out for the Maghrib Prayer. So when it was time for Maghrab, he performed all its Rakat’s. Then Allah Almighty blessed him by giving him good things.”

Then Ibn Abi Awfa said: “I asked Abu Huraira about this, so he told me that I had done right and there is no blame on you regarding the Asr prayer which you prayed in your house."

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Umm Qais bint Mihsan said:                     "I asked the Messenger of Allah about menstrual blood that gets on clothing. He said, 'Wash it with water and lote leaves, and rub it, even with a piece of stick.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، وعبد الرحمن بن مهدي، قالا حدثنا سفيان، عن ثابت بن هرمز أبي المقدام، عن عدي بن دينار، عن أم قيس بنت محصن، قالت سألت رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن دم الحيض يصيب الثوب قال ‏"‏ اغسليه بالماء والسدر وحكيه ولو بضلع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, “It is recommended a Muslim to perform ablution (wudu) before every prayer.”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)wentout one day to pray for rain. He led us in praying two Rak’ahwithout any Adhan or Iqamah, then he addressed us and supplicated toAllah. He turned to face the Qiblah, raising his hands, then heturnedhis cloak around, putting its right on the left and its lefton theright.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن الأزهر، والحسن بن أبي الربيع، قالا حدثنا وهب بن جرير، حدثنا أبي قال، سمعت النعمان، يحدث عن الزهري، عن حميد بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبي هريرة، قال خرج رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يوما يستسقي فصلى بنا ركعتين بلا أذان ولا إقامة ثم خطبنا ودعا الله وحول وجهه نحو القبلة رافعا يديه ثم قلب رداءه فجعل الأيمن على الأيسر والأيسر على الأيمن ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer in his house with his family then he went out and they recognized him, so he hastened to complete it before the sun set.” Then Jabir bin Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them) came forward and said, "You have done right. Indeed, I used to do that when I was young." So Ibn Abi Awfa asked me about my intention in saying this, and I replied: “I did not intend anything except what the Prophet’s Messenger (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) stated.” Then Jabir bin Abdullah said, "Indeed, I heard the Messenger of Allah (Peace Be Upon Him) say: ‘Whoever prays Asr prayer with his family in his house then he goes out to pray before sunset, it is as if he prayed two Rak’ahs.'"

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Ali bin Abu Talib said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) commanded me to look after his sacrificial camels, to share outtheir covers and skins, and not to give the butcher any of it. Hesaid: ‘We will give him (his wages).’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن الصباح، أنبأنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عبد الكريم، عن مجاهد، عن ابن أبي ليلى، عن علي بن أبي طالب، قال أمرني رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أن أقوم على بدنه وأن أقسم جلالها وجلودها وأن لا أعطي الجازر منها شيئا وقال ‏"‏ نحن نعطيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about what Allah had commanded him to perform in Hajj, so Jaaber said: “I was told by my father (Abdullah) that Allah ordered him to circumambulate the Kaaba seven times and then pray two Rak’ahs.” Then I asked Jaabar about praying with it. He replied ‘No,’ saying 'It is a Sunnah.’

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Uthman bin Abul-‘As said:                      “The Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) said: ‘I hear an infant crying so I make the prayershort.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسماعيل بن أبي كريمة الحراني، حدثنا محمد بن سلمة، عن محمد بن عبد الله بن علاثة، عن هشام بن حسان، عن الحسن، عن عثمان بن أبي العاص، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إني لأسمع بكاء الصبي فأتجوز في الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “I asked Jaafar bin Aboahurairah about praying behind a man who was wearing silk, and he told me: 'You should not pray behind one who is wearing silk.' Then I asked him again about praying behind a man who was wearing wool, and he replied that it was permissible.’”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Kathir bin Murrah that Abu Fatimah told him:                      “Isaid:‘O Messenger of Allah! Tell me of a deed that I can adhere toandact upon.’ He said: “You should prostrate, for you will notprostrate to Allah but He will raise you in status one degree therebyand erase from you one sin.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، وعبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم الدمشقيان، قالا حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن ثابت بن ثوبان، عن أبيه، عن مكحول، عن كثير بن مرة، أن أبا فاطمة، حدثه قال قلت يا رسول الله أخبرني بعمل، أستقيم عليه وأعمله ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ عليك بالسجود فإنك لا تسجد لله سجدة إلا رفعك الله بها درجة وحط بها عنك خطيئة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “A man prayed Asr prayer with his hand on his heart while he was praying.” He then asked him about it and he replied, "He is trying to strengthen the faith in his heart." Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade this.

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri that the Messenger ofAllah(ﷺ) said:                      "Gog and Magog people will be set free and they willemerge as Allah says: "swoop(ing) down from every mound."[21:96]Theywill spread throughout the earth, and the Muslims will flee fromthemuntil the remainder of the Muslims are in their cities andfortresses,taking their flocks with them. They will pass by a riverand drinkfrom it, until they leave nothing behind, and the last ofthem willfollow in their footsteps and one of them will say: 'Therewas oncewater in this place.' They will prevail over the earth, thentheirleader will say: 'These are the people of the earth, and wehavefinished them off. Now let us fight the people of heaven!' Thenoneof them will throw his spear towards the sky, and it will comebackdown smeared with blood. And they will say: 'We have killed thepeople of heaven.' While they are like that, Allah will send a wormlike the worm that is found in the noses of sheep, which willpenetrate their necks and they will die like locusts, one on top ofanother. In the morning the Muslims will not hear any sound fromthem,and they will say: 'Who will sell his soul for the sake ofAllah andsee what they are doing?' A man will go down, havingprepared himselfto be killed by them, and he will find them dead, sohe will call outto them: 'Be of good cheer, for your enemy is dead!'Then the peoplewill come out and let their flocks loose, but theywill not haveanything to graze on except their flesh, and they willbecome very fatas if they were grazing on the best vegetation theyever found.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا يونس بن بكير، عن محمد بن إسحاق، حدثني عاصم بن عمر بن قتادة، عن محمود بن لبيد، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ تفتح يأجوج ومأجوج فيخرجون كما قال الله تعالى ‏{وهم من كل حدب ينسلون}‏ فيعمون الأرض وينحاز منهم المسلمون حتى تصير بقية المسلمين في مدائنهم وحصونهم ويضمون إليهم مواشيهم حتى أنهم ليمرون بالنهر فيشربونه حتى ما يذرون فيه شيئا فيمر آخرهم على أثرهم فيقول قائلهم لقد كان بهذا المكان مرة ماء ويظهرون على الأرض فيقول قائلهم هؤلاء أهل الأرض قد فرغنا منهم ولننازلن أهل السماء حتى إن أحدهم ليهز حربته إلى السماء فترجع مخضبة بالدم فيقولون قد قتلنا أهل السماء ‏.‏ فبينما هم كذلك إذ بعث الله دواب كنغف الجراد فتأخذ بأعناقهم فيموتون موت الجراد يركب بعضهم بعضا فيصبح المسلمون لا يسمعون لهم حسا فيقولون من رجل يشري نفسه وينظر ما فعلوا فينزل منهم رجل قد وطن نفسه على أن يقتلوه فيجدهم موتى فيناديهم ألا أبشروا فقد هلك عدوكم ‏.‏ فيخرج الناس ويخلون سبيل مواشيهم فما يكون لهم رعى إلا لحومهم فتشكر عليها كأحسن ما شكرت من نبات أصابته قط ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira – may Allah grant him relief - about a dream which came to me in which I was riding on a horse with a white face, until it stopped at an area where there were two paths. Then a man appeared and said, “This is the path of Paradise and this is the path of Hell.” So I chose the path of Paradise and when I reached its end, I found myself in my house as if nothing had happened.

Then I asked Abu Huraira – may Allah grant him relief - about another dream which came to me in which I was riding on a horse with a white face, until it stopped at an area where there were two paths. Then a man appeared and said, “This is the path of Paradise and this is the path of Hell.” So I chose the path of Hell and when I reached its end, I found myself in my house as if nothing had happened.

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا علي بن مسهر، عن الحجاج، عن الحكم بن عتيبة، عن مقسم، عن ابن عباس، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا رمى جمرة العقبة مضى ولم يقف ‏.‏

chapter: The Chapters on Blood Money - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Miqdam Ash-Shami that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “I am the heir of the one who has no heir, and I will pay blood money on his behalf and inherit from him, and the maternal uncle is the heir of the one who has no heir; he pays the blood money on his behalf and inherits from him.'”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن درست، حدثنا حماد بن زيد، عن بديل بن ميسرة، عن علي بن أبي طلحة، عن راشد بن سعد، عن أبي عامر الهوزني، عن المقدام الشامي، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أنا وارث من لا وارث له أعقل عنه وأرثه والخال وارث من لا وارث له يعقل عنه ويرثه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira regarding a man who killed his brother and was given compensation (blood money) from him; is he to take it? He said, "Yes." I then asked, “And if the one receiving the blood money did not like taking it?” He replied, “He should take it.” Then Ibn Majah inquired of me about this Hadith.

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Amrah said:                      “I asked ‘Aishah: ‘How did theMessenger of Allah (ﷺ) perform prayer?’ She said: ‘When theProphet(ﷺ) performed ablution, he would put his hand in the vesseland sayBismillah, and he would perform ablution properly. Then hewould standand face the Qiblah. He would say the Takbir raising hishandsparallel to his shoulders. Then he would bow, putting his handson hisknees and keeping his arms away from his sides. Then he wouldraisehis head and straighten his back, and he would stand a littlelongerthan your standing. Then he would prostrate, pointing hishandstowards the Qiblah, keeping his arms away (from his sides) asmuch aspossible, according to what I have seen. Then he would raisehis headand sit on his left foot with his right foot held upright,and hedisliked leaning towards his left side.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن حارثة بن أبي الرجال، عن عمرة، قالت سألت عائشة كيف كانت صلاة رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قالت كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا توضأ فوضع يديه في الإناء سمى الله ويسبغ الوضوء ثم يقوم فيستقبل القبلة فيكبر ويرفع يديه حذاء منكبيه ثم يركع فيضع يديه على ركبتيه ويجافي بعضديه ثم يرفع رأسه فيقيم صلبه ويقوم قياما هو أطول من قيامكم قليلا ثم يسجد فيضع يديه تجاه القبلة ويجافي بعضديه ما استطاع فيما رأيت ثم يرفع رأسه فيجلس على قدمه اليسرى وينصب اليمنى ويكره أن يسقط على شقه الأيسر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaafir bin Sumrad about praying behind a man who was wearing silk garments and he replied, 'It is not permissible for you to pray behind him.' Then I asked another person regarding the same matter and he said ‘Yes it’s permitted.’ So I went back to Jaafar and told him of this. He then said: “If one does not know that the garment was made from silk or wool, then there's no objection.”

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Humaid bin Nafi' that:                     he heard Zainab the daughter of Umm Salamah narrating that she heard Umm Salamah and Umm Habibah mention that a woman carne to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that her daughter's husband had died, and she was suffering from an eye disease, and she wanted to apply kohl to her eyes (as a remedy). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "One of you would throw a she-camel's dropping when a year had passed (since the death of her husband. Rather it is four months and ten (days)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، أنبأنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن حميد بن نافع، ‏.‏ أنه سمع زينب ابنة أم سلمة، تحدث أنها سمعت أم سلمة، وأم حبيبة تذكران أن امرأة أتت النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقالت إن ابنة لها توفي عنها زوجها فاشتكت عينها فهي تريد أن تكحلها ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ قد كانت إحداكن ترمي بالبعرة عند رأس الحول وإنما هي أربعة أشهر وعشرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: “If a man divorced his wife three times in menstruation or otherwise lawful, then he restores her to what was before divorce and gives her her Mahr.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abdullah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'No one will enter Paradise who has even a mustard-seed's weight of arrogance in his heart, and no one will enter Hell who has even a mustard-seed's weight of faith in his heart.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا علي بن مسهر، عن الأعمش، ح وحدثنا علي بن ميمون الرقي، حدثنا سعيد بن مسلمة، عن الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن عبد الله، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا يدخل الجنة من كان في قلبه مثقال حبة من خردل من كبر ولا يدخل النار من كان في قلبه مثقال حبة من خردل من إيمان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say all of its prescribed units.” Then he recited: "So establish prayers with us and glorify the name of your Lord in the morning and evening."

chapter: The Chapters on Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Zainab bint Abi Salamah:                     that the wives of the Prophet all differed with 'Aishah and refused to allow anyone with ties of breastfeeding like Salim, the freed salve of Abu Hudhaifah, to enter upon them. They said: “How do we know? That may be a concession granted only to Salim.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح المصري، حدثنا عبد الله بن لهيعة، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، وعقيل، عن ابن شهاب، أخبرني أبو عبيدة بن عبد الله بن زمعة، عن أمه، زينب بنت أبي سلمة أنها أخبرته أن أزواج النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  كلهن خالفن عائشة وأبين أن يدخل عليهن أحد بمثل رضاعة سالم مولى أبي حذيفة وقلن وما يدرينا لعل ذلك كانت رخصة لسالم وحده ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him: “The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade a man from marrying a woman of his mother's tribe, and he did so three times.” Then Ibn Abbas asked me about it, and I replied, "I think this was because of the possibility of discord between them."

chapter: The Chapters on Legal Punishments - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Umamah bin Sahl bin Hunaif that:                     `Uthman bin 'Affan looked at them when they spoke of killing. He said: “Are they kill threatening to kill me? Why would they kill me? I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: “It is not lawful to shed the blood of a Muslim except in one of three (cases): a man who commits adultery when he is a married person, then he should be stoned; a man who kills a soul not in retaliation for murder; and a man who apostatizes after becoming Muslim.' By Allah (SWT), I never committed adultery either during Ignorance days nor in Islam, and I have never killed a Muslim soul, and I have not apostatized since I became Muslim.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عبدة، أنبأنا حماد بن زيد، عن يحيى بن سعيد، عن أبي أمامة بن سهل بن حنيف، أن عثمان بن عفان، أشرف عليهم فسمعهم وهم، يذكرون القتل فقال إنهم ليتواعدوني بالقتل فلم يقتلوني وقد سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ لا يحل دم امرئ مسلم إلا في إحدى ثلاث رجل زنى وهو محصن فرجم أو رجل قتل نفسا بغير نفس أو رجل ارتد بعد إسلامه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فوالله ما زنيت في جاهلية ولا في إسلام ولا قتلت نفسا مسلمة ولا ارتددت منذ أسلمت ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from giving in charity until he had paid back his debt.”

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Qais bin ‘Ubaid said:                      “I heard Abu Dharrswearingthat these verses were revealed concerning those six peopleon theDay of Badr: ‘These two opponents (believers and disbelievers)dispute with each other about their Lord.”[22:19] to the words“Verily, Allah does what he wills.’[22:14] (that is) Hamzah bin‘Abdul-Muttalib, ‘Ali bin Abi Talib, ‘Ubaidah bin Al-Harith,‘Utbahbin Rabi’ah, Shaibah bin Rabi’ah and Al-Walid bin‘Utbah. They arguedwith one another on the Day of Badr.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن حكيم، وحفص بن عمرو، قالا حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، ح وحدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل، أنبأنا وكيع، قالا حدثنا سفيان، عن أبي هاشم الرماني، - قال أبو عبد الله هو يحيى بن الأسود - عن أبي مجلز، عن قيس بن عباد، قال سمعت أبا ذر، يقسم لنزلت هذه الآيات في هؤلاء الرهط الستة يوم بدر ‏{‏هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم‏}‏ إلى قوله‏:‏ ‏{‏ إن الله يفعل ما يريد‏}‏ في حمزة بن عبد المطلب وعلي بن أبي طالب وعبيدة بن الحارث وعتبة بن ربيعة وشيبة بن ربيعة والوليد بن عتبة اختصموا في الحجج يوم بدر ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Ibn Sinan about a man who prayed as one of the people of the mosque but did not perform Jihad (struggle). He said, “He is like a plant whose roots are dry.” Then Jabir bin Abdullah came and said, "I have heard my father [Jabir] say: ‘A Muslim’s heart becomes dead if he does not struggle in the path of Allah.’”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Musa Al-Ash’ari:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)addressed us and explained the Sunnah for us, and he taught us ourprayer. He said: ‘When you perform prayer, and you are sitting, letthe first thing you say be: At-Tahiyyatut-tayyibatus-salawatu lillah;as-salamu ‘alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu;as-salamu ‘alayna wa ‘ala ‘ibadillahis-salihin. Ashhadu an lailaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa Rasuluhu (Allcompliments, good words and prayers are due to Allah; peace be uponyou, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings; peace beupon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness thatnone has the right to be worshipped but Allah and I bear witness thatMuhammad is His slave and Messenger). Seven phrases which are thegreeting of the prayer.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا جميل بن الحسن، حدثنا عبد الأعلى، حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، ح وحدثنا عبد الرحمن بن عمر، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، حدثنا سعيد بن أبي عروبة، وهشام بن أبي عبد الله، عن قتادة، ‏.‏ وهذا حديث عبد الرحمن عن يونس بن جبير، عن حطان بن عبد الله، عن أبي موسى الأشعري، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  خطبنا وبين لنا سنتنا وعلمنا صلاتنا فقال ‏"‏ إذا صليتم فكان عند القعدة فليكن من أول قول أحدكم التحيات الطيبات الصلوات لله السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله سبع كلمات هن تحية الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “I asked Jaafar bin Aboahurairah about praying behind a man who was wearing musk, and he replied: 'You should not pray behind one who is smelling of musk.'"

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Urwah bin Zubair that 'Abdullah bin Zubair told him that:                     A man from the Ansar had a dispute with Zubair in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) concerning a stream in the Harrah which they used to irrigate the date-palm trees. The Ansari said: "Let the water flow" but Zubair refused. So they referred that dispute to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who said: "Irrigate (your land), O Zubair., and then let the water flow to your neighbor." The Ansari became angry and said "O Messenger of Allah, is it because he is your cousin?" The face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) changed color (because of anger) and he said: "O Zubair, irrigate (your land) then block the water until it flows back to the walls around the date-palm trees." Zubair said: "By Allah, I think that this verse was revealed concerning this matter. ' But no, by your Lord, they can have no Faith, until they make you (O Muhammad) judge in all disputes between them, and find in themselves no resistance against your decisions, and accept (them) with full submission.' "
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رمح بن المهاجر المصري، أنبأنا الليث بن سعد، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة بن الزبير، أن عبد الله بن الزبير، حدثه أن رجلا من الأنصار خاصم الزبير عند رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  في شراج الحرة التي يسقون بها النخل فقال الأنصاري سرح الماء يمر ‏.‏ فأبى عليه فاختصما عند رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ اسق يا زبير ثم أرسل الماء إلى جارك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فغضب الأنصاري فقال يا رسول الله أن كان ابن عمتك فتلون وجه رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ثم قال ‏"‏ يا زبير اسق ثم احبس الماء حتى يرجع إلى الجدر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فقال الزبير والله إني لأحسب هذه الآية نزلت في ذلك {فلا وربك لا يؤمنون حتى يحكموك فيما شجر بينهم ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت ويسلموا تسليما}‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say what Allah has commanded in it.” Then he recited: "So turn your face towards Him (in worship), surely the religion is His."

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that ‘Abdur-Rahman bin Shibl said:                      “The Messenger ofAllah (ﷺ) forbade three things: Pecking like a crow, spreading (theforearms) like a beast of prey, and a man having a place in themosquein which he usually offers the prayer, like a camel has aplace towhich it usually goes.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، ح وحدثنا أبو بشر، بكر بن خلف حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، قالا حدثنا عبد الحميد بن جعفر، عن أبيه، عن تميم بن محمود، عن عبد الرحمن بن شبل، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن ثلاث عن نقرة الغراب وعن فرشة السبع وأن يوطن الرجل المكان الذي يصلي فيه كما يوطن البعير ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “A man prayed Asr prayer with a small number of Rak'ahs (units) in his house and then he went out for the Maghrib Prayer. So when it was time for Maghrab, he performed all its Rakat’s. Then Allah Almighty blessed him by giving him abundant sustenance.”

Then Ibn Abi Awfa said: “I asked Abu Huraira about this, so he told me that I had heard from Jabir ibn Abdullah who narrated to us from the Prophet (peace be upon him) saying: ‘Whoever performs Asr prayer with a small number of Rak'ahs and then goes out for Maghrib Prayer, it is as if he has performed all its Rakat’s.’”

chapter: The Chapters on Business Transactions - كتاب التجارات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Umamah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah, forbade selling or buying singing girls, and their wages, and consuming their price."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى بن سعيد القطان، حدثنا هاشم بن القاسم، حدثنا أبو جعفر الرازي، عن عاصم، عن أبي المهلب، عن عبيد الله الإفريقي، عن أبي أمامة، قال نهى رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  عن بيع المغنيات وعن شرائهن وعن كسبهن وعن أكل أثمانهن ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) said: “There is no riba [interest] except in permissible transactions.”

chapter: The Chapters on Pre-emption - كتاب الشفعة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “There is no preemption for a partner when his co-partner has beaten him to it (in another deal before), not for a minor nor one who is absent.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، قال حدثنا محمد بن الحارث، عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن البيلماني، عن أبيه، عن ابن عمر، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا شفعة لشريك على شريك إذا سبقه بالشراء ولا لصغير ولا لغائب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira regarding pre-emption (Shufaa’), and he said to me: “Pre-emption is permissible as long as you are buying from a Muslim, and if the seller says ‘I am selling it for this price,’ then you may buy at that price. If he changes his mind and increases the price, you have the right to buy it from him at whatever price was originally agreed upon.”

chapter: Chapters on Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Umamah Al-Bahili that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)said:                      “Night and day will not cease until a group among mynationdrinks wine, calling it by some other name.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا العباس بن الوليد الدمشقي، حدثنا عبد السلام بن عبد القدوس، حدثنا ثور بن يزيد، عن خالد بن معدان، عن أبي أمامة الباهلي، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا تذهب الليالي والأيام حتى تشرب طائفة من أمتي الخمر يسمونها بغير اسمها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who drinks wine and then prays Asharah (the daily prayers), so Jaafar said, “He is not considered to have committed shirk.”

chapter: The Chapters on Blood Money - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Salamah bin Rawh bin Zinba', that :                     his grandfather came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he had castrated a slave of his. The Prophet (ﷺ) manumitted the slave in compensation for having been mutilated.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسحاق بن منصور، قال حدثنا عبد السلام، عن إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي فروة، عن سلمة بن روح بن زنباع، عن جده، أنه قدم على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وقد خصى غلاما له فأعتقه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالمثلة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ bin al-Harba’: I asked Abu Huraira: “Is it permissible to take compensation (blood money) from a man who has killed one of our people?” He said, "Yes.” I then asked him, “If he kills another person in retaliation,” he replied, “It is also permissible." Then Ibn Majah inquired and said, "Do you permit taking blood money for the killing of an innocent (person)?“ Abu Huraira responded, “Indeed! If a man killed one of our people, we would take compensation from him.”

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Shuraih Al-Khuzai that the Prophet(ﷺ) said:                     "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عمرو بن دينار، سمع نافع بن جبير، يخبر عن أبي شريح الخزاعي، أن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليحسن إلى جاره ومن كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليكرم ضيفه ومن كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليقل خيرا أو ليسكت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, “It is recommended that a Muslim should say his prayers in such a way as to prevent others from disturbing him with their movements or voices.”

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد، حدثنا عبدة بن سليمان، عن سعيد بن أبي عروبة، عن قتادة، عن الحسن، عن سمرة بن جندب، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  نهى عن بيع الحيوان بالحيوان نسيئة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa came to Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) with a piece of cloth and said, “I bought this from you for such an amount.” He then took it back from him and gave him the same amount. Then Allah’s Messenger (pbuh) forbade doing so, stating: "Do not do that because I am afraid that perhaps someone might say to me ‘He has taken advantage of his messenger.’”

chapter: Chapters on Hajj Rituals - كتاب المناسك
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)performed ‘Umrah four times: The ‘Umrah of Hudaibiyah, the ‘Umrahtomake up for (the one not completed previously), the third fromJi’ranah and the fourth that he did with his Hajj.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو إسحاق الشافعي، إبراهيم بن محمد حدثنا داود بن عبد الرحمن، عن عمرو بن دينار، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال اعتمر رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أربع عمر عمرة الحديبية وعمرة القضاء من قابل والثالثة من الجعرانة والرابعة التي مع حجته ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin Abdullah about the intention (niyyah) of Hajj, and Jaaber said to him, “You should say, 'I intend for Allah alone, intending pilgrimage.’” Then Jabir recited: "And [say], 'My Lord, if You would only know what I do see!' Indeed, it is a grievous burden upon me.'"

chapter: The Chapters on Jihad - كتاب الجهاد
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Usamah bin Said said:                      “The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)sent me to a village called Ubna, and said: “Go to Ubna in themorning and burn it.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن إسماعيل بن سمرة، حدثنا وكيع، عن صالح بن أبي الأخضر، عن الزهري، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن أسامة بن زيد، قال بعثني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى قرية يقال لها أبنى فقال ‏"‏ ائت أبنى صباحا ثم حرق ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Ibn Masruq about a man who prayed as much as he could in his household, then he did not perform Jihad; so Ibn Masruk said to him: “He is like the tree which produces fruit but does not give it away.”

ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Dharr said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)said:‘When anyone of you gets up to perform prayer, then indeed mercyisfacing him, so he should not smooth the pebbles.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، ومحمد بن الصباح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن أبي الأحوص الليثي، عن أبي ذر، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ إذا قام أحدكم إلى الصلاة فإن الرحمة تواجهه فلا يمسح الحصى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “A man prayed Asr prayer in his house with his family, then he went out for a while and when he returned, the sun was setting. So Allah Almighty ordered me by my heart to pray Maghrib prayer. Then I performed it (Maghrab) before its time.”

Then Ibn Abi Awfa said: “I asked him about this,” so he replied, "Indeed, I prayed Asr with my family and then went out for a while until the sun was setting; when I returned, I found that Maghrib prayer had already begun. So Allah Almighty ordered me by my heart to pray it before its time.”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Ibn ‘Abbas said:                      “When the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ)prayed Tahajjud at night, he would say: “Allahumma lakal-hamd,Antanurus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Wa lakal-hamd, Antaqayyamus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Wa lakal-hamd, Antamalikus-samawati wal-ard wa man fihinna. Wa lakal-hamd, Antal-haqq,wa wa’dukahaqq, wa liqa’uka haqq, wa qawluka haqq, wal-jannatuhaqq, wan-nabiyyuna haqq, wa Muhammadun haqq. Allahumma laka aslamtu,wa bikaamantu, wa ‘alaika tawakkaltu wa ilaika anabtu, wa bikakhasamtu, wailaika hakamtu, faghfirli ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu,wa ma asrartuwa ma a’lantu. Antal-muqaddimu wa Antal-muakhkhiru.La ilaha illa antawa la ilaha ghairuka, wa la hawla wa la quwwatailla bika (O allah, toyou is praise, You are the Light of theheavens and the earth, andeveryone therein. To You is praise, Youare the Sustainer of theheavens and the earth, and everyone therein.To You is praise, You arethe Sovereign of the heavens and the earth,and everyone therein. ToYou is praise, You are the Truth; Yourpromise is true, the meetingwith You is true, Your saying is true,Paradise is true, the Fire istrue, the Hour is true, the Prophetsare true, and Muhammad is true. OAllah, to You have I submitted, inYou I believe, in You have I put mytrust, to You I turn inrepentance, by Your help I argue, to You Irefer my case, so forgiveme for my past and future sins, what I havedone in secret and what Ihave done openly. You are the One Who bringsforward and puts back.None has the right to be worshipped but You,and there is none whohas the right to be worshipped other than You.And there is no powerand no strength except with You.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن سليمان الأحول، عن طاوس، عن ابن عباس، قال كان رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إذا تهجد من الليل قال ‏"‏ اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ولك الحمد أنت قيام السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ولك الحمد أنت مالك السموات والأرض ومن فيهن ولك الحمد أنت الحق ووعدك حق ولقاؤك حق وقولك حق والجنة حق والنار حق والساعة حق والنبيون حق ومحمد حق اللهم لك أسلمت وبك آمنت وعليك توكلت وإليك أنبت وبك خاصمت وإليك حاكمت فاغفر لي ما قدمت وما أخرت وما أسررت وما أعلنت أنت المقدم وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت ولا إله غيرك ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him, “I asked Jaabir about praying behind a man who was wearing musk (perfume), and he told me, 'You should not pray behind one who is wearing musk.'" Then Jabir recited: "O you who have been given good news! Take your right hand and put it on your left shoulder; then perform the prayer with all your strength."

chapter: Tribulations - كتاب الفتن
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Hudhaifah bin Yaman that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                      “There will be tribulations at the gates of which willbecallers (calling people) to Hell. Dying when you are biting ontothestump of a tree will be better for you than following anyone ofthem.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عمر بن علي المقدمي، حدثنا سعيد بن عامر، حدثنا أبو عامر الخزاز، عن حميد بن هلال، عن عبد الرحمن بن قرط، عن حذيفة بن اليمان، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ تكون فتن على أبوابها دعاة إلى النار فأن تموت وأنت عاض على جذل شجرة خير لك من أن تتبع أحدا منهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: I asked Abu Huraira: “What is a trial (fitnah)?” He said to me, "It is that which you think it will pass over but does not pass over.”

chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Anas said:                     "The Prophet(ﷺ) used to come to us and say to a brother of mine, who was small: 'O Abu Umair.'".
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، عن شعبة، عن أبي التياح، عن أنس، قال كان النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  يأتينا فيقول لأخ لي وكان صغيرا ‏"‏ يا أبا عمير ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Angari said to him: “A man entered upon Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) while he was eating, so he ordered the table to be removed.” Then Hudhayf bin Al-Yala’ came and said, "I saw Allah’s Messenger (pbuh) forbidding a person from entering on someone who was eating." So Abu Huraira repeated what had been said. The Prophet (peace be upon him) then said: “If anyone among you enters to see another eating, he should not disturb him; if he wishes to give something, let him do so through the door.”

chapter: The Chapters on Wills - كتاب الوصايا
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:                     “A man may do the deeds of the people of goodness for seventy years, then when he makes his will, he is unjust in his will, so he ends (his life) with evil deeds and enters Hell. And a man may do the people of evil for seventy years, then he is just in his will, so he ends (his life) with good deeds and enters Paradise.”Abu Hurairah said: “Recite, if you wish: “These are the limits (set by) Allah (STW) up to His saying: 'a disgraceful torment'”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن الأزهر، حدثنا عبد الرزاق بن همام، أنبأنا معمر، عن أشعث بن عبد الله، عن شهر بن حوشب، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن الرجل ليعمل بعمل أهل الخير سبعين سنة فإذا أوصى حاف في وصيته فيختم له بشر عمله فيدخل النار وإن الرجل ليعمل بعمل أهل الشر سبعين سنة فيعدل في وصيته فيختم له بخير عمله فيدخل الجنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو هريرة واقرءوا إن شئتم ‏{تلك حدود الله}‏ إلى قوله {عذاب مهين}‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: “If a man makes a will, he should write it down with his own hand.”

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Aswad bin Qais that he heard Nubaih Al-‘Anazisay:                      “Iheard Jabir bin ‘Abdullah say: ‘The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)commanded that the slain of the battle of Uhud should be returned tothe battlefield; they had been moved to Al-Madinah.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هشام بن عمار، وسهل بن أبي سهل، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الأسود بن قيس، سمع نبيحا العنزي، يقول سمعت جابر بن عبد الله، يقول إن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  أمر بقتلى أحد أن يردوا إلى مصارعهم وكانوا نقلوا إلى المدينة ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Laytha’ ibn Musa’: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: “Whoever accompanies a deceased person from behind the coffin to his grave, seventy bow lengths are forgiven.”

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jami' bin Shaddad - AbuSakhrah - said:                     "I heard Humran telling Abu Burdah in the mosque that he had heard 'Uthman bin 'Affan narrating that the Prophet had said" 'Whoever performs ablution perfectly as Allah has enjoined, then his prescribed prayer will serve as expiation for what is between them."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن جامع بن شداد أبي صخرة، قال سمعت حمران، يحدث أبا بردة في المسجد أنه سمع عثمان بن عفان، يحدث عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من أتم الوضوء كما أمره الله فالصلوات المكتوبات كفارات لما بينهن ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying, “It is recommended a Muslim to perform ablution (ghusl) after sneezing or vomiting.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Allah refuses to accept the good deeds of one who follows innovation until he gives up that innovation.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن سعيد، حدثنا بشر بن منصور الخياط، عن أبي زيد، عن أبي المغيرة، عن عبد الله بن عباس، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ أبى الله أن يقبل عمل صاحب بدعة حتى يدع بدعته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: “If anyone testifies that there is no deity but Allah and that Muhammad is His messenger, then all his past sins are forgiven.”

chapter: Chapters Regarding Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Jabir bin Samurah that a man from among theCompanionsof the Prophet (ﷺ) was wounded, and the wound caused hima greatdeal of pain. chapter: Etiquette - كتاب الأدب
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Bakr Siddiq(RA) that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                     "No person who mistreats his slave will enter Paradise." They said: " O Messenger of Allah, did you  not tell us that this nation will have more slaves and orphans than any other nation?" He said: " Yes, so be as kind to them as you are to your own children, and feed them with the same food that you eat." They said: "What will benefit us in this world?" He said: "A horse that is kept ready for fighting in the cause of Allah, and your slave to take care of you, and if he performs prayer, then he is your brother(in Islam)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا إسحاق بن سليمان، عن مغيرة بن مسلم، عن فرقد السبخي، عن مرة الطيب، عن أبي بكر الصديق، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا يدخل الجنة سيئ الملكة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا يا رسول الله أليس أخبرتنا أن هذه الأمة أكثر الأمم مملوكين ويتامى قال ‏"‏ نعم فأكرموهم ككرامة أولادكم وأطعموهم مما تأكلون ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا فما ينفعنا في الدنيا قال ‏"‏ فرس ترتبطه تقاتل عليه في سبيل الله مملوكك يكفيك فإذا صلى فهو أخوك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Angari said to him: “A man entered upon Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) while he was eating, so he ordered the table to be removed.”

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Anas bin Malik narrated that:                     Abu Bakr Siddiq wrote to him: “In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. This is the obligation of Sadaqah which the Messenger of Allah enjoined upon the Muslims, as Allah commanded the Messenger of Allah. The ages of camels to be given (in Zakat) may be made up in sheep. So if a man has camels on which the Sadaqah is a Jadha'ah (a four-year-old she-camel) and he does not have a Jadha'ah but he has a Hiqqah (a three year old she-camel), then the Hiqqah should be accepted from him, and two sheep should be given (in addition), if they are readily available, or twenty Dirham. If a man has camels on which the Sadaqah is a Hiqqah, and he only has a Bin Labun( a two-year-old she-camel), then the Bint Labun should be accepted from him, along with two sheep or twenty Dirhams.If a man has camels on which the sadaqah is a Bint Labun, and he does not have one, but he has a Hiqqah, then it should be accepted from him, and the Zakat collector should give him back twenty Dirham or two sheep. If a man has camels on which Sadaqah is a Bint Labun, and he does not have one, but he has a Bint Makhad(a one-year-old she-camel), then the Bint Makhad should be accepted from him, along with twenty Dirham or two sheep. If a man has camels on which the Sadaqah is a Bint Makhad, and he does not have one, but he has a Bint Labun, then the Bint Labun should be accepted from him, and the Zakat collector should give him back twenty Dirhams or two sheep. Whoever does not have a Bint Makhad, but he has a Bint Labun (a two-year-old male camel), then it should be accepted from him and nothing else should be given along with it.' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، ومحمد بن يحيى، ومحمد بن مرزوق، قالوا حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن المثنى، حدثني أبي، عن ثمامة، حدثني أنس بن مالك، أن أبا بكر الصديق، كتب له بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ‏.‏ هذه فريضة الصدقة التي فرض رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  على المسلمين التي أمر الله بها رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فإن من أسنان الإبل في فرائض الغنم من بلغت عنده من الإبل صدقة الجذعة وليس عنده جذعة وعنده حقة فإنها تقبل منه الحقة ويجعل مكانها شاتين إن استيسرتا أو عشرين درهما ومن بلغت عنده صدقة الحقة وليست عنده إلا بنت لبون فإنها تقبل منه بنت لبون ويعطي معها شاتين أو عشرين درهما ومن بلغت صدقته بنت لبون وليست عنده وعنده حقة فإنها تقبل منه الحقة ويعطيه المصدق عشرين درهما أو شاتين ومن بلغت صدقته بنت لبون وليست عنده وعنده بنت مخاض فإنها تقبل منه ابنة مخاض ويعطي معها عشرين درهما أو شاتين ‏.‏ ومن بلغت صدقته بنت مخاض وليست عنده وعنده ابنة لبون فإنها تقبل منه بنت لبون ويعطيه المصدق عشرين درهما أو شاتين فمن لم يكن عنده ابنة مخاض على وجهها وعنده ابن لبون ذكر فإنه يقبل منه وليس معه شىء ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Musa: I asked Jaafir about a man who gave Zakat from his property to another without knowing whether he was entitled to it or not; should he still give him something? He said, "Yes." I then asked, “And if the latter had no right to it?” He replied, “He would be given some.”

chapter: Supplication - كتاب الدعاء
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that :                     the Messenger of Allah (saas) taught her this supplication: "Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam.  Wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma la a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannatah wa ma qarrab ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa a'udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amalin, wa as'aluka an taj'al kulla qada'in qadaytahuli khayran (O Allah, I ask You for all that is good, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all evil, in this world and in the Hereafter, what I know and what I do not know.  O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your slave and Prophet has asked You for, and I seek refuge with You from the evil from which Your slave and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and for that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed, and I seek refuge in You from Hell and from that which brings one closer to it, in word and deed. And I ask You to make every decree that You decree concerning me good)."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا عفان، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، أخبرني جبر بن حبيب، عن أم كلثوم بنت أبي بكر، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  علمها هذا الدعاء ‏"‏ اللهم إني أسألك من الخير كله عاجله وآجله ما علمت منه وما لم أعلم وأعوذ بك من الشر كله عاجله وآجله ما علمت منه وما لم أعلم اللهم إني أسألك من خير ما سألك عبدك ونبيك وأعوذ بك من شر ما عاذ به عبدك ونبيك اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وما قرب إليها من قول أو عمل وأعوذ بك من النار وما قرب إليها من قول أو عمل وأسألك أن تجعل كل قضاء قضيته لي خيرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: “If anyone makes a supplication to Allah with his right hand raised, intending sincerely, then his prayer is granted.”

ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said:                     "If a man were to fill his stomach completely with pus until it destroyed him, that would be better for him than filling (his mind) with poetry."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا حفص، وأبو معاوية ووكيع عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لأن يمتلئ جوف الرجل قيحا حتى يريه خير له من أن يمتلئ شعرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إلا أن حفصا لم يقل يريه ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Angari said to him: “A man entered upon Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) while he was eating, so he ordered the table to be removed and his food scattered among the poor.”

chapter: Chapters on Dress - كتاب اللباس
ground_truth_en: ‘Alibin Abu Talib said:                      “The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took hold ofsomesilk in his left hand and some gold in his right, then he raisedhishands and said: ‘These two are forbidden for the males of mynation, and permitted to the females.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر، حدثنا عبد الرحيم بن سليمان، عن محمد بن إسحاق، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن عبد العزيز بن أبي الصعبة، عن أبي الأفلح الهمداني، عن عبد الله بن زرير الغافقي، سمعته يقول سمعت علي بن أبي طالب، يقول أخذ رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  حريرا بشماله وذهبا بيمينه ثم رفع بهما يديه فقال ‏"‏ إن هذين حرام على ذكور أمتي حل لإناثهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Chapters on Divorce - كتاب الطلاق
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Sanabil said:                     "Subai'ah Aslamiyyah bint Harith gave birth twenty-odd days after her husband died. When her postnatal bleeding ended, she adorned herself, and was criticized for doing that. Her case was mentioned to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: 'If she does that, then her waiting period is over."'
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو الأحوص، عن منصور، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن أبي السنابل، قال وضعت سبيعة الأسلمية بنت الحارث حملها بعد وفاة زوجها ببضع وعشرين ليلة فلما تعلت من نفاسها تشوفت فعيب ذلك عليها وذكر أمرها للنبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ إن تفعل فقد مضى أجلها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who divorced his wife during menstruation, so Jaafar said “He should give her Mahr (dowry) and she is entitled to half of what was given.” Then Ibn Masruq came and said "I have heard from the Prophet - peace be upon him – that he forbade giving Mahr or taking back." So I asked Abu Huraira about this, and he replied “The Messenger of Allah -peace be upon him- did not forbid it except when there were witnesses present.”

chapter: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them - كتاب إقامة الصلاة والسنة فيها
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated that Abu Hurairah said:                      “The Prophet (ﷺ) came outtopray and said the Takbir, then he gestured to them to wait. He wentand took a bath, and his head was dripping with water while he ledthem in prayer. When he finished he said: ‘I came out to you in astate of sexual impurity, and I forgot until I had started to pray.’”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يعقوب بن حميد بن كاسب، حدثنا عبد الله بن موسى التيمي، عن أسامة بن زيد، عن عبد الله بن يزيد، مولى الأسود بن سفيان عن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن ثوبان، عن أبي هريرة، قال خرج النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إلى الصلاة وكبر ثم أشار إليهم فمكثوا ثم انطلق فاغتسل وكان رأسه يقطر ماء فصلى بهم فلما انصرف قال ‏"‏ إني خرجت إليكم جنبا وإني نسيت حتى قمت في الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abi Awfa said to him: “A man prayed Asr prayer with his hands raised until he was about to finish it, then he lowered them and finished the prayer.” Then Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) forbade this. He said, "Do not do that; rather, raise your arms till you are satisfied with their position."

chapter: The Chapters Regarding Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Salman bin Amir Dabbi narrated that:                     the Messenger of Allah said: “Charity given to the poor is charity, and that given to a relative is two things: charity and upholding the ties of kinship.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، عن ابن عون، عن حفصة بنت سيرين، عن الرباب أم الرائح بنت صليع، عن سلمان بن عامر الضبي، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ الصدقة على المسكين صدقة وهي على ذي القرابة اثنتان صدقة وصلة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Musa: I asked Jaafir about a man who gave Zakat from his property to another without knowing if he was entitled to it; should he be rewarded? He said, "Yes." I then asked him, “And what if the person did not need it?” He said, “He is given reward.”

He replied: "You should perform your prayers as you see fit."

chapter: Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Abu Sa’eed Al-Khudri that:                      The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) observed I’tifak in a Turkish tent, over the door of whichwas apiece of reed matting. He pushed the mat aside, then he put hisheadout and spoke to the people.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الأعلى الصنعاني، حدثنا المعتمر بن سليمان، حدثني عمارة بن غزية، قال سمعت محمد بن إبراهيم، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  اعتكف في قبة تركية على سدتها قطعة حصير ‏.‏ قال فأخذ الحصير بيده فنحاها في ناحية القبة ثم أطلع رأسه فكلم الناس ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about fasting on consecutive days, and he said, “It is recommended to fast one day consecutively with another.” He then added, "And if you wish to do so, it does not harm you. chapter: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations - كتاب المساجد والجماعات
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Wathilah bin Asqa' that:                     The Prophet said: "Keep your infants, your insane and your evil ones away from your mosques. Avoid engaging in transactions and disputes, raising your voices, carrying out your prescribed punishments and unsheathing your swords therein. Make places for purification at their gates, and perfume them with incense on Fridays." (Maudu')

llm_response: Narrated By ‘Uthman ibn Hunayf: I heard my father say: “Whoever prays in a mosque with his heart in it, Allah will forgive him.”

chapter: The Chapters on Blood Money - كتاب الديات
ground_truth_en: 'Amr bin Shu'aib narrated from his father that his grandfather said:                     “A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) screaming. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: 'What is the matter with you?' He said: 'My master saw me kissing a slave woman of his, so he cut off my penis.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said: 'Take me to the man.' He was sought but could not be found, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Go, for you are free.' He said: 'Who will protect me, O Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? What if my master enslaves me again?' The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Your protection will be (incumbent upon) every believer or Muslim.'”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا رجاء بن المرجى السمرقندي، حدثنا النضر بن شميل، حدثنا أبو حمزة الصيرفي، حدثني عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده، قال جاء رجل إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم صارخا فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ما لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال سيدي رآني أقبل جارية له فجب مذاكيري ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ على بالرجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فطلب فلم يقدر عليه ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذهب فأنت حر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال على من نصرتي يا رسول الله قال يقول أرأيت إن استرقني مولاى فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ على كل مؤمن أو مسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I asked Abu Huraira regarding a man who killed his brother and was given compensation (blood money) from him; is it permissible to take that? He said, "Yes." I then asked, “And if he took the entire amount?” He replied, “No, but half.” Then I asked again, “And what about one-third?" He stated, “No, but a quarter.”

chapter: Chapters on Food - كتاب الأطعمة
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from Sahl bin Mu’adh bin Anas Al-Juhani, from hisfather,that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Whoever eats food and said: Al-hamdulillahil-ladhi at’amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlinminniwa la quwwatin (Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this andprovidedit for me without any strength or power on my part), - hisprevioussins will be forgiven.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا حرملة بن يحيى، حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني سعيد بن أبي أيوب، عن أبي مرحوم عبد الرحيم، عن سهل بن معاذ بن أنس الجهني، عن أبيه، عن النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من أكل طعاما فقال الحمد لله الذي أطعمني هذا ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who eats his food with his hand while it is still hot; should he say, “Alhamdulillah”? He said, "Yes." Then he added, "Should he say, 'La ilaha illallah'? Yes.” And then he added, ‘Should he say, ‘SubhanAllah’? Yes.’"

ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Jabir bin 'Abdullah said:                     "We came to a pond in which there was the carcass of a donkey, so we refrained from using the water until the Messenger of Allah came to us and said: 'Water is not made impure by anything.' Then we drank from it and gave it to our animals to drink, and we carried some with us."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن سنان، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، حدثنا شريك، عن طريف بن شهاب، قال سمعت أبا نضرة، يحدث عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال انتهينا إلى غدير فإذا فيه جيفة حمار ‏.‏ قال فكففنا عنه حتى انتهى إلينا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ إن الماء لا ينجسه شىء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فاستقينا وأروينا وحملنا ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who used to pray as usual but then died while his prayer was being answered, so Allah inflicted upon him punishment. He said, “It is because of the intention with which he prayed.”

chapter: Chapters on Hunting - كتاب الصيد

(Sahih)Another chain with similar wording.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح، وحرملة بن يحيى المصريان، قالا حدثنا عبد الله بن وهب، قال أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال ‏"‏ من أدرك من الصبح ركعة قبل أن تطلع الشمس فقد أدركها ومن أدرك من العصر ركعة قبل أن تغيب الشمس فقد أدركها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حدثنا جميل بن الحسن، حدثنا عبد الأعلى، حدثنا معمر، عن الزهري، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال فذكر نحوه ‏.‏
llm_response:
Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a prayer which was performed by Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) in the morning, and it consisted of four Rakats; then he used to perform another one after Fajr.

So when Salah came out for me, I did as he had done, but I forgot to recite any verses from Al-Fatiha during my prayer. So I performed the rest of the Rakat without reciting anything, and then I recited it in the next Rakah. Then I said: "O Allah forgive me."

Then Jabir bin ‘Abdullah came to me and he said: “You have forgotten Al-Fatihah? Verily, you should always recite it.”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever relieves a Muslim of some worldly distress, Allah will relieve him of some of the distress of the Day of Resurrection, and whoever conceals (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will conceal him (his faults) in this world and the Day of Resurrection. And whoever relives the burden from a destitute person, Allah will relieve him in this world and the next. Allah will help His slave so long as His slave helps his brother. Whoever follows a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy fro him a path to paradise. No people gather in one of the houses of Allah, reciting the Book of Allah and teaching it to one another, but the angels will surround them, tranquility will descend upon them, mercy will envelop them and Allah will mention them to those who are with Him. And whoever is hindered because of his bad deeds, his lineage will be of no avail to him.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ من نفس عن مؤمن كربة من كرب الدنيا نفس الله عنه كربة من كرب يوم القيامة ومن ستر مسلما ستره الله في الدنيا والآخرة ومن يسر على معسر يسر الله عليه في الدنيا والآخرة والله في عون العبد ما كان العبد في عون أخيه ومن سلك طريقا يلتمس فيه علما سهل الله له به طريقا إلى الجنة وما اجتمع قوم في بيت من بيوت الله يتلون كتاب الله ويتدارسونه بينهم إلا حفتهم الملائكة ونزلت عليهم السكينة وغشيتهم الرحمة وذكرهم الله فيمن عنده ومن أبطأ به عمله لم يسرع به نسبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaafir bin Jabr about a man who prayed as he pleased; so he said to him, “He is not from me.” Then I heard it from Ibn Abi Hatim regarding a man who used to pray at night and then would sleep for three quarters of the night; so he said to him, "He is not from me." And I also heard it from Abu Huraira that Jaafir bin Jabr asked ‘Uthman ibn Hanafi about a man who prayed as he pleased; so he said to him “He is not from me.”

ground_truth_ar: حدثنا بشر بن آدم، حدثنا روح بن عبادة، عن ابن جريج، عن حبيب بن أبي ثابت، عن عاصم بن ضمرة، عن علي، قال قال لي النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  ‏"‏ لا تبرز فخذك ولا تنظر إلى فخذ حى ولا ميت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Layth ibn Adiy: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, "When a person dies, call out ‘Allahu Akbar,’ say, 'This is one of those who were warned,' then recite with him until you reach the grave." Then he said, “And when you bury him, say, ‘O Allah, forgive him and grant him ease.’”

chapter: The Book of the Sunnah - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah embraced me and said: 'O Allah, teach him wisdom and the (correct) interpretation of the Book.'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، وأبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي قالا حدثنا عبد الوهاب، حدثنا خالد الحذاء، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال ضمني رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  إليه وقال ‏"‏ اللهم علمه الحكمة وتأويل الكتاب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Abbas said to him, “The prayer is complete when you say, 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wahi'uhu.’” Then he recited the verse of Surat Al-Fathra (Chapter 35) "Read in the name of your Lord most Gracious – The one who taught man standing..."

chapter: Supplication - كتاب الدعاء
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from 'Aishah that she said:                     "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think I should say in my supplication, if I come upon Laylatul-Qadr?" He said: "Say: 'Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa, fa'fu 'anni (O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me).'"
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا وكيع، عن كهمس بن الحسن، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن عائشة، أنها قالت يا رسول الله أرأيت إن وافقت ليلة القدر ما أدعو قال ‏"‏ تقولين اللهم إنك عفو تحب العفو فاعف عني ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: “If anyone makes a supplication to Allah with his right hand raised, intending sincerely, then his prayer is granted.”

chapter: The Chapters on Pawning - كتاب الرهون
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Simak that the heard Musa bin Talhah bin `Ubaidullah narrating that his father said:                     “I passed by some palm trees with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he saw some people  pollinating the trees. He said: 'What are these people doing?' They said: 'They are taking something from the male part (of the plant) and putting it in the female part.' He said: 'I do not think that this will do any good.' News of that reached them, so they stopped doing it, and their yield declined. News of that reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said: 'That was only my thought. If it will do any good, then do it. I am only a human being like you, and what I think may be right or wrong. But When I tell you: “Allah (SWT) says,” I will never tell lies about Allah (SWT).' ”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا علي بن محمد، حدثنا عبيد الله بن موسى، عن إسرائيل، عن سماك، أنه سمع موسى بن طلحة بن عبيد الله، يحدث عن أبيه، قال مررت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في نخل فرأى قوما يلقحون النخل فقال ‏"‏ ما يصنع هؤلاء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا يأخذون من الذكر فيجعلونه في الأنثى ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ ما أظن ذاك يغني شيئا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فبلغهم فتركوه ونزلوا عنها فبلغ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ إنما هو ظن إن كان يغني شيئا فاصنعوه فإنما أنا بشر مثلكم وإن الظن يخطئ ويصيب ولكن ما قلت لكم قال الله فلن أكذب على الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By Al-Laytha’ ibn Ya'qub: I heard Abu Huraira saying that he asked Jaabir bin ‘Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who pawned his garment, and it was eaten by moths; what is the opinion of Islam regarding this? He said, “If he did not know that eating occurs in garments, then there is no sin on him. But if he knew that eating occurred in garments, then he should have taken care of it.”

chapter: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah - كتاب الطهارة وسننها
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that 'Abdur-Rahman bin Hasanah said:                     "The Messenger of Allah came out to us holding a small shield in his hand. He put it down, then he sat down and urinated towards it. Some of the people said: 'Look at him, he urinates like a woman!' The Prophet heard that and said: 'Woe to you! Do you not know what happened to one of the children of Israel? If any urine touched any part of their clothes, they would cut that out with scissors. He told them not to do that, so he was tormented in his grave.'" (Da'if)Another chain with similar wording.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن زيد بن وهب، عن عبد الرحمن ابن حسنة، قال خرج علينا رسول الله  صلى الله عليه وسلم  وفي يده الدرقة فوضعها ثم جلس فبال إليها فقال بعضهم انظروا إليه يبول كما تبول المرأة ‏.‏ فسمعه النبي  صلى الله عليه وسلم  فقال ‏"‏ ويحك أما علمت ما أصاب صاحب بني إسرائيل كانوا إذا أصابهم البول قرضوه بالمقاريض فنهاهم عن ذلك فعذب في قبره ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: “I heard Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him) saying: 'No fault does anyone commit which is more pleasing to Allah than giving of one’s property for His sake.’”

chapter: Chapters on Shares of Inheritance - كتاب الفرائض
ground_truth_en: It wasnarrated from ‘Aishah that the freed slave of the Prophet(ﷺ)fell from a palm tree and died. He left behind wealth but he hadnochild or close relative. The Prophet (ﷺ) said:                      “Give his legacyto a man from his village.”
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا سفيان، عن عبد الرحمن بن الأصبهاني، عن مجاهد بن وردان، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن عائشة، أن مولى، للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وقع من نخلة فمات وترك مالا ولم يترك ولدا ولا حميما فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أعطوا ميراثه رجلا من أهل قريته ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Narrated By al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib: I heard Abu Huraira saying that Ibn Masud said to him, “A man may inherit from his father a piece of land which he did not cultivate; it is for him.” Then Hudhayf bin Al Yaman asked him and said, "Do you permit this?" He replied, “Yes, if the son had no need thereof."
